verses.hebrew: מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בֶן־דָּוִד מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: The proverbs of Shelomo the son of David, king of Yisra᾽el;

verses.hebrew: לָדַעַת חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר לְהָבִין אִמְרֵי בִינָה׃
verses.english: to know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

verses.hebrew: לָקַחַת מוּסַר הַשְׂכֵּל צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט וּמֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: to receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

verses.hebrew: לָתֵת לִפְתָאיִם עָרְמָה לְנַעַר דַּעַת וּמְזִמָּה׃
verses.english: to give prudence to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁמַע חָכָם וְיוֹסֶף לֶקַח וְנָבוֹן תַּחְבֻּלוֹת יִקְנֶה׃
verses.english: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain to wise counsels:

verses.hebrew: לְהָבִין מָשָׁל וּמְלִיצָה דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים וְחִידֹתָם׃
verses.english: to understand a proverb, and a figure; the words of the wise, and their riddles.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה רֵאשִׁית דָּעַת חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר אֱוִילִים בָּזוּ׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע בְּנִי מוּסַר אָבִיךָ וְאַל־תִּטֹּשׁ תּוֹרַת אִמֶּךָ׃
verses.english: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and do not forsake the Tora of thy mother:

verses.hebrew: כִּי לִוְיַת חֵן הֵם לְרֹאשֶׁךָ וַעֲנָקִים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: for they shall be a graceful garland for thy head, and chains about thy neck.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־יְפַתּוּךָ חַטָּאִים אַל־תֹּבֵא׃
verses.english: My son, if sinners entice thee, do not consent.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יֹאמְרוּ לְכָה אִתָּנוּ נֶאֶרְבָה לְדָם נִצְפְּנָה לְנָקִי חִנָּם׃
verses.english: If they say, Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, let us lurk for the innocent without cause:

verses.hebrew: נִבְלָעֵם כִּשְׁאוֹל חַיִּים וּתְמִימִים כְּיוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃
verses.english: let us swallow them up alive like She᾽ol; and whole, like those who go down into the pit:

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הוֹן יָקָר נִמְצָא נְמַלֵּא בָתֵּינוּ שָׁלָל׃
verses.english: we shall find all precious goods; we shall fill our houses with spoil:

verses.hebrew: גּוֹרָלְךָ תַּפִּיל בְּתוֹכֵנוּ כִּיס אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לְכֻלָּנוּ׃
verses.english: throw in thy lot among us; we shall all have one purse:

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אַל־תֵּלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אִתָּם מְנַע רַגְלְךָ מִנְּתִיבָתָם׃
verses.english: my son, do not walk in the way with them; restrain thy foot from their path:

verses.hebrew: כִּי רַגְלֵיהֶם לָרַע יָרוּצוּ וִימַהֲרוּ לִשְׁפָּךְ־דָּם׃
verses.english: for their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed blood.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִנָּם מְזֹרָה הָרָשֶׁת בְּעֵינֵי כָל־בַּעַל כָּנָף׃
verses.english: For no heed is taken of the net which is spread in the sight of any bird.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵם לְדָמָם יֶאֱרֹבוּ יִצְפְּנוּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָם׃
verses.english: And they lie in wait for their blood; they lurk for their lives.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן אָרְחוֹת כָּל־בֹּצֵעַ בָּצַע אֶת־נֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלָיו יִקָּח׃
verses.english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy of gain; it takes away the life of its owner.

verses.hebrew: חָכְמוֹת בַּחוּץ תָּרֹנָּה בָּרְחֹבוֹת תִּתֵּן קוֹלָהּ׃
verses.english: Wisdom cries aloud in the street; she utters her voice in the squares:

verses.hebrew: בְּרֹאשׁ הֹמִיּוֹת תִּקְרָא בְּפִתְחֵי שְׁעָרִים בָּעִיר אֲמָרֶיהָ תֹאמֵר׃
verses.english: she cries in the chief place of concourse, at the entrances of the gates: in the city she utters her words, saying,

verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי פְּתָיִם תְּאֵהֲבוּ פֶתִי וְלֵצִים לָצוֹן חָמְדוּ לָהֶם וּכְסִילִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־דָעַת׃
verses.english: How long, you simple ones, will you love being simple? and how long, O scorners, will you delight in scoffing, and fools hate knowledge?

verses.hebrew: תָּשׁוּבוּ לְתוֹכַחְתִּי הִנֵּה אַבִּיעָה לָכֶם רוּחִי אוֹדִיעָה דְבָרַי אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: turn at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit to you, I will make known to you my words.

verses.hebrew: יַעַן קָרָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵנוּ נָטִיתִי יָדִי וְאֵין מַקְשִׁיב׃
verses.english: Because I have called, and you refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְרְעוּ כָל־עֲצָתִי וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לֹא אֲבִיתֶם׃
verses.english: but you have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי בְּאֵידְכֶם אֶשְׂחָק אֶלְעַג בְּבֹא פַחְדְּכֶם׃
verses.english: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear comes upon you;

verses.hebrew: בְּבֹא כשאוה [כְשׁוֹאָה ] פַּחְדְּכֶם וְאֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָה יֶאֱתֶה בְּבֹא עֲלֵיכֶם צָרָה וְצוּקָה׃
verses.english: when your fear comes like a storm, and your calamity comes like a tempest; when distress and anguish come upon you.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִקְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹא אֶעֱנֶה יְשַׁחֲרֻנְנִי וְלֹא יִמְצָאֻנְנִי׃
verses.english: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they will not find me:

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת כִּי־שָׂנְאוּ דָעַת וְיִרְאַת יְהֹוָה לֹא בָחָרוּ׃
verses.english: for they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:

verses.hebrew: לֹא־אָבוּ לַעֲצָתִי נָאֲצוּ כָּל־תּוֹכַחְתִּי׃
verses.english: they would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

verses.hebrew: וְיֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִי דַרְכָּם וּמִמֹּעֲצֹתֵיהֶם יִשְׂבָּעוּ׃
verses.english: Therefore they shall eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מְשׁוּבַת פְּתָיִם תַּהַרְגֵם וְשַׁלְוַת כְּסִילִים תְּאַבְּדֵם׃
verses.english: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the erring of fools shall destroy them.

verses.hebrew: וְשֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׁכָּן־בֶּטַח וְשַׁאֲנַן מִפַּחַד רָעָה׃
verses.english: But he who listens to me shall dwell safely, and shall be at ease without fear of evil.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־תִּקַּח אֲמָרָי וּמִצְוֺתַי תִּצְפֹּן אִתָּךְ׃
verses.english: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and treasure up my commandments with thee;

verses.hebrew: לְהַקְשִׁיב לַחָכְמָה אָזְנֶךָ תַּטֶּה לִבְּךָ לַתְּבוּנָה׃
verses.english: so that thou incline thy ear to wisdom, and apply thy heart to understanding indeed,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם לַבִּינָה תִקְרָא לַתְּבוּנָה תִּתֵּן קוֹלֶךָ׃
verses.english: if thou criest after wisdom, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

verses.hebrew: אִם־תְּבַקְשֶׁנָּה כַכָּסֶף וְכַמַּטְמוֹנִים תַּחְפְּשֶׂנָּה׃
verses.english: if thou seekest her like silver, and searchest for her as for hidden treasures;

verses.hebrew: אָז תָּבִין יִרְאַת יְהוָה וְדַעַת אֱלֹהִים תִּמְצָא׃
verses.english: then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה יִתֵּן חָכְמָה מִפִּיו דַּעַת וּתְבוּנָה׃
verses.english: For the Lord gives wisdom: out of his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.hebrew: וצפן [יִצְפֹּן] לַיְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּה מָגֵן לְהֹלְכֵי תֹם׃
verses.english: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a shield to those who walk uprightly,

verses.hebrew: לִנְצֹר אָרְחוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וְדֶרֶךְ חסידו [חֲסִידָיו] יִשְׁמֹר׃
verses.english: to keep the paths of justice; and he preserves the way of his pious ones.

verses.hebrew: אָז תָּבִין צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט וּמֵישָׁרִים כָּל־מַעְגַּל־טוֹב׃
verses.english: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and justice and equity, every good path:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תָבוֹא חָכְמָה בְלִבֶּךָ וְדַעַת לְנַפְשְׁךָ יִנְעָם׃
verses.english: for wisdom shall enter thy heart, and knowledge be pleasant to thy soul;

verses.hebrew: מְזִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹר עָלֶיךָ תְּבוּנָה תִנְצְרֶכָּה׃
verses.english: discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

verses.hebrew: לְהַצִּילְךָ מִדֶּרֶךְ רָע מֵאִישׁ מְדַבֵּר תַּהְפֻּכוֹת׃
verses.english: to deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man who speaks perverse things;

verses.hebrew: הַעֹזְבִים אָרְחוֹת יֹשֶׁר לָלֶכֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

verses.hebrew: הַשְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂוֹת רָע יָגִילוּ בְּתַהְפֻּכוֹת רָע׃
verses.english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of the wicked;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶם עִקְּשִׁים וּנְלוֹזִים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָם׃
verses.english: whose ways are crooked, and who are underhand in their paths:

verses.hebrew: לְהַצִּילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁה זָרָה מִנָּכְרִיָּה אֲמָרֶיהָ הֶחֱלִיקָה׃
verses.english: to deliver thee from the strange woman, from the alien woman who speaks so smoothly;

verses.hebrew: הַעֹזֶבֶת אַלּוּף נְעוּרֶיהָ וְאֶת־בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיהָ שָׁכֵחָה׃
verses.english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁחָה אֶל־מָוֶת בֵּיתָהּ וְאֶל־רְפָאִים מַעְגְּלֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: For her house inclines to death, and her paths to the dead.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־בָּאֶיהָ לֹא יְשׁוּבוּן וְלֹא־יַשִּׂיגוּ אָרְחוֹת חַיִּים׃
verses.english: None that go to her return, nor do they regain the paths of life:

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תֵּלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ טוֹבִים וְאָרְחוֹת צַדִּיקִים תִּשְׁמֹר׃
verses.english: that thou mayst walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְשָׁרִים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָרֶץ וּתְמִימִים יִוָּתְרוּ בָהּ׃
verses.english: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the innocent shall remain in it.

verses.hebrew: וּרְשָׁעִים מֵאֶרֶץ יִכָּרֵתוּ וּבוֹגְדִים יִסְּחוּ מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the faithless shall be rooted out of it.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי תּוֹרָתִי אַל־תִּשְׁכָּח וּמִצְוֺתַי יִצֹּר לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: My son, forget not my Tora; but let thy heart keep my commandments:

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֹרֶךְ יָמִים וּשְׁנוֹת חַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם יוֹסִיפוּ לָךְ׃
verses.english: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

verses.hebrew: חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אַל־יַעַזְבֻךָ קָשְׁרֵם עַל־גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶיךָ כָּתְבֵם עַל־לוּחַ לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Let not loyal love and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thy heart:

verses.hebrew: וּמְצָא־חֵן וְשֵׂכֶל־טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי אֱלֹהִים וְאָדָם׃
verses.english: so shalt thou find grace and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

verses.hebrew: בְּטַח אֶל־יְהוָה בְּכָל־לִבֶּךָ וְאֶל־בִּינָתְךָ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵן׃
verses.english: Trust in the Lord with all thy heart; and do not lean upon thy own understanding.

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ דָעֵהוּ וְהוּא יְיַשֵּׁר אֹרְחֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי חָכָם בְּעֵינֶיךָ יְרָא אֶת־יְהוָה וְסוּר מֵרָע׃
verses.english: Be not wise in thy own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.

verses.hebrew: רִפְאוּת תְּהִי לְשָׁרֶּךָ וְשִׁקּוּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

verses.hebrew: כַּבֵּד אֶת־יְהוָה מֵהוֹנֶךָ וּמֵרֵאשִׁית כָּל־תְּבוּאָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thy increase:

verses.hebrew: וְיִמָּלְאוּ אֲסָמֶיךָ שָׂבָע וְתִירוֹשׁ יְקָבֶיךָ יִפְרֹצוּ׃
verses.english: so shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy vats shall burst with new wine.

verses.hebrew: מוּסַר יְהוָה בְּנִי אַל־תִּמְאָס וְאַל־תָּקֹץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: My son, do not despise the chastening of the Lord; nor be weary of his correction:

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר יֶאֱהַב יְהוָה יוֹכִיחַ וּכְאָב אֶת־בֵּן יִרְצֶה׃
verses.english: for the Lord reproves him whom he loves: even as a father the son in whom he delights.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם מָצָא חָכְמָה וְאָדָם יָפִיק תְּבוּנָה׃
verses.english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, and the man who gets understanding.

verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב סַחְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־כָּסֶף וּמֵחָרוּץ תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃
verses.english: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and its gain than fine gold.

verses.hebrew: יְקָרָה הִיא מפניים [מִפְּנִינִים] וְכָל־חֲפָצֶיךָ לֹא יִשְׁווּ־בָהּ׃
verses.english: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared to her.

verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים בִּימִינָהּ בִּשְׂמֹאולָהּ עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד׃
verses.english: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand are riches and honour.

verses.hebrew: דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹעַם וְכָל־נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

verses.hebrew: עֵץ־חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ וְתֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר׃
verses.english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold on her: and happy are those who hold her fast.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּחָכְמָה יָסַד־אָרֶץ כּוֹנֵן שָׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָה׃
verses.english: The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he estab­lished the heavens.

verses.hebrew: בְּדַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמוֹת נִבְקָעוּ וּשְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ־טָל׃
verses.english: By his knowledge the depths were broken up, and the clouds drop down dew.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אַל־יָלֻזוּ מֵעֵינֶיךָ נְצֹר תֻּשִׁיָּה וּמְזִמָּה׃
verses.english: My son, let them not depart from thy eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

verses.hebrew: וְיִהְיוּ חַיִּים לְנַפְשֶׁךָ וְחֵן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: so shall they be life to thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

verses.hebrew: אָז תֵּלֵךְ לָבֶטַח דַּרְכֶּךָ וְרַגְלְךָ לֹא תִגּוֹף׃
verses.english: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

verses.hebrew: אִם־תִּשְׁכַּב לֹא־תִפְחָד וְשָׁכַבְתָּ וְעָרְבָה שְׁנָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: indeed, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּירָא מִפַּחַד פִּתְאֹם וּמִשֹּׁאַת רְשָׁעִים כִּי תָבֹא׃
verses.english: Be not afraid of sudden fear, nor of the ruin of the wicked, when it comes.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה יִהְיֶה בְכִסְלֶךָ וְשָׁמַר רַגְלְךָ מִלָּכֶד׃
verses.english: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being caught.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּמְנַע־טוֹב מִבְּעָלָיו בִּהְיוֹת לְאֵל ידיך [יָדְךָ] לַעֲשׂוֹת׃
verses.english: Withhold not good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thy hand to do it.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֹּאמַר לרעיך [לְרֵעֲךָ ] לֵךְ וָשׁוּב וּמָחָר אֶתֵּן וְיֵשׁ אִתָּךְ׃
verses.english: Say not to thy neighbour, Go, and come back, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּחֲרֹשׁ עַל־רֵעֲךָ רָעָה וְהוּא־יוֹשֵׁב לָבֶטַח אִתָּךְ׃
verses.english: Do not devise evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwells securely by thee.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תרוב [תָּרִיב] עִם־אָדָם חִנָּם אִם־לֹא גְמָלְךָ רָעָה׃
verses.english: Do not strive with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּאִישׁ חָמָס וְאַל־תִּבְחַר בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו׃
verses.english: Do not envy the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה נָלוֹז וְאֶת־יְשָׁרִים סוֹדוֹ׃
verses.english: For the underhand man is abomination to the Lord: and he shares his counsel with the righteous.

verses.hebrew: מְאֵרַת יְהוָה בְּבֵית רָשָׁע וּנְוֵה צַדִּיקִים יְבָרֵךְ׃
verses.english: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesses the habitation of the just.

verses.hebrew: אִם־לַלֵּצִים הוּא־יָלִיץ ולעניים [וְלַעֲנָוִים] יִתֶּן־חֵן׃
verses.english: Surely he scorns the scorners: but he gives grace to the humble.

verses.hebrew: כָּבוֹד חֲכָמִים יִנְחָלוּ וּכְסִילִים מֵרִים קָלוֹן׃
verses.english: The wise shall inherit honour: but fools shall get shame.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ בָנִים מוּסַר אָב וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ לָדַעַת בִּינָה׃
verses.english: Hear, you children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם תּוֹרָתִי אַל־תַּעֲזֹבוּ׃
verses.english: For I give you good doctrine, forsake not my Tora.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בֵן הָיִיתִי לְאָבִי רַךְ וְיָחִיד לִפְנֵי אִמִּי׃
verses.english: For I was my father’s son, tender and the only one in the sight of my mother.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרֵנִי וַיֹּאמֶר לִי יִתְמָךְ־דְּבָרַי לִבֶּךָ שְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וֶחְיֵה׃
verses.english: He taught me also, and said to me, Let thy heart hold fast to my words: keep my commandments, and live.

verses.hebrew: קְנֵה חָכְמָה קְנֵה בִינָה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח וְאַל־תֵּט מֵאִמְרֵי־פִי׃
verses.english: Get wisdom, get understanding: do not forget it; nor decline from the words of my mouth.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּעַזְבֶהָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶךָּ אֱהָבֶהָ וְתִצְּרֶךָּ׃
verses.english: Do not forsake her, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה קְנֵה חָכְמָה וּבְכָל־קִנְיָנְךָ קְנֵה בִינָה׃
verses.english: The beginning of wisdom is, Get wisdom: therefore use all your means to acquire understanding.

verses.hebrew: סַלְסְלֶהָ וּתְרוֹמְמֶךָּ תְּכַבֵּדְךָ כִּי תְחַבְּקֶנָּה׃
verses.english: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she will bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

verses.hebrew: תִּתֵּן לְרֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־חֵן עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת תְּמַגְּנֶךָּ׃
verses.english: She shall give to thy head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she bestow on thee.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע בְּנִי וְקַח אֲמָרָי וְיִרְבּוּ לְךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּים׃
verses.english: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

verses.hebrew: בְּדֶרֶךְ חָכְמָה הֹרֵתִיךָ הִדְרַכְתִּיךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־יֹשֶׁר׃
verses.english: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of rectitude.

verses.hebrew: בְּלֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־יֵצַר צַעֲדֶךָ וְאִם־תָּרוּץ לֹא תִכָּשֵׁל׃
verses.english: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be confined; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

verses.hebrew: הַחֲזֵק בַּמּוּסָר אַל־תֶּרֶף נִצְּרֶהָ כִּי־הִיא חַיֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרַח רְשָׁעִים אַל־תָּבֹא וְאַל־תְּאַשֵּׁר בְּדֶרֶךְ רָעִים׃
verses.english: Do not enter into the path of the wicked, and do not go in the way of evil men.

verses.hebrew: פְּרָעֵהוּ אַל־תַּעֲבָר־בּוֹ שְׂטֵה מֵעָלָיו וַעֲבוֹר׃
verses.english: Avoid it, do not pass by it, turn from it, and pass on.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יִשְׁנוּ אִם־לֹא יָרֵעוּ וְנִגְזְלָה שְׁנָתָם אִם־לֹא יכשולו [יַכְשִׁילוּ׃]
verses.english: For they sleep not, unless they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לָחֲמוּ לֶחֶם רֶשַׁע וְיֵין חֲמָסִים יִשְׁתּוּ׃
verses.english: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹרַח צַדִּיקִים כְּאוֹר נֹגַהּ הוֹלֵךְ וָאוֹר עַד־נְכוֹן הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: But the path of just men is like the gleam of sunlight, that shines ever more brightly until the height of noonday.

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים כָּאֲפֵלָה לֹא יָדְעוּ בַּמֶּה יִכָּשֵׁלוּ׃
verses.english: The way of the wicked is like darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי לִדְבָרַי הַקְשִׁיבָה לַאֲמָרַי הַט־אָזְנֶךָ׃
verses.english: My son, attend to my words; incline thy ear to my sayings.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יַלִּיזוּ מֵעֵינֶיךָ שָׁמְרֵם בְּתוֹךְ לְבָבֶךָ׃
verses.english: Let them not depart from thy eyes; keep them in the midst of thy heart.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חַיִּים הֵם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶם וּלְכָל־בְּשָׂרוֹ מַרְפֵּא׃
verses.english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to all their flesh.

verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־מִשְׁמָר נְצֹר לִבֶּךָ כִּי־מִמֶּנּוּ תּוֹצְאוֹת חַיִּים׃
verses.english: Keep thy heart with the greatest vigilance; for out of it are the issues of life.

verses.hebrew: הָסֵר מִמְּךָ עִקְּשׁוּת פֶּה וּלְזוּת שְׂפָתַיִם הַרְחֵק מִמֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: Put away from thee a dissembling mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

verses.hebrew: עֵינֶיךָ לְנֹכַח יַבִּיטוּ וְעַפְעַפֶּיךָ יַיְשִׁרוּ נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Let thy eyes look right on, and let thy eyelids look straight before thee.

verses.hebrew: פַּלֵּס מַעְגַּל רַגְלֶךָ וְכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ יִכֹּנוּ׃
verses.english: Make even the path of thy foot, and let all thy ways be firm.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּט־יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול הָסֵר רַגְלְךָ מֵרָע׃
verses.english: Do not turn to the right hand or to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי לְחָכְמָתִי הַקְשִׁיבָה לִתְבוּנָתִי הַט־אָזְנֶךָ׃
verses.english: My son, attend to my wisdom, and bend thy ear to my understanding:

verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמֹר מְזִמּוֹת וְדַעַת שְׂפָתֶיךָ יִנְצֹרוּ׃
verses.english: that thou mayst preserve discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

verses.hebrew: כִּי נֹפֶת תִּטֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵי זָרָה וְחָלָק מִשֶּׁמֶן חִכָּהּ׃
verses.english: For the lips of a strange woman drip honey, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָה כַלַּעֲנָה חַדָּה כְּחֶרֶב פִּיּוֹת׃
verses.english: but her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two edged sword.

verses.hebrew: רַגְלֶיהָ יֹרְדוֹת מָוֶת שְׁאוֹל צְעָדֶיהָ יִתְמֹכוּ׃
verses.english: Her feet go down to death: her steps take hold of She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: אֹרַח חַיִּים פֶּן־תְּפַלֵּס נָעוּ מַעְגְּלֹתֶיהָ לֹא תֵדָע׃
verses.english: She is far from measuring her way of life; her paths wander, and she is ignorant.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי וְאַל־תָּסוּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי־פִי׃
verses.english: Hear me now therefore, O children, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.

verses.hebrew: הַרְחֵק מֵעָלֶיהָ דַרְכֶּךָ וְאַל־תִּקְרַב אֶל־פֶּתַח בֵּיתָהּ׃
verses.english: Remove thy way far from her, and do not come near the door of her house:

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־תִּתֵּן לַאֲחֵרִים הוֹדֶךָ וּשְׁנֹתֶיךָ לְאַכְזָרִי׃
verses.english: lest thou give thy vigour to others, and thy years to the cruel one:

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִשְׂבְּעוּ זָרִים כֹּחֶךָ וַעֲצָבֶיךָ בְּבֵית נָכְרִי׃
verses.english: lest strangers be filled with thy strength; and thy labours go to the house of a stranger:

verses.hebrew: וְנָהַמְתָּ בְאַחֲרִיתֶךָ בִּכְלוֹת בְּשָׂרְךָ וּשְׁאֵרֶךָ׃
verses.english: and thou moan when thy end comes, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵיךְ שָׂנֵאתִי מוּסָר וְתוֹכַחַת נָאַץ לִבִּי׃
verses.english: and thou say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל מוֹרָי וְלִמְלַמְּדַי לֹא־הִטִּיתִי אָזְנִי׃
verses.english: And I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor bent my ear to those who instructed me!

verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט הָיִיתִי בְכָל־רָע בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל וְעֵדָה׃
verses.english: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

verses.hebrew: שְׁתֵה־מַיִם מִבּוֹרֶךָ וְנֹזְלִים מִתּוֹךְ בְּאֵרֶךָ׃
verses.english: Drink waters out of thy own cistern, and running waters out of thy own well.

verses.hebrew: יָפוּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶיךָ חוּצָה בָּרְחֹבוֹת פַּלְגֵי־מָיִם׃
verses.english: So will thy spring be dispersed abroad, and streams of water will flow in the broad places.

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ־לְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ וְאֵין לְזָרִים אִתָּךְ׃
verses.english: Let them be only thy own, and not strangers’ with thee.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־מְקוֹרְךָ בָרוּךְ וּשְׂמַח מֵאֵשֶׁת נְעוּרֶךָ׃
verses.english: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

verses.hebrew: אַיֶּלֶת אֲהָבִים וְיַעֲלַת־חֵן דַּדֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּךָ בְכָל־עֵת בְּאַהֲבָתָהּ תִּשְׁגֶּה תָמִיד׃
verses.english: A loving hind and a pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה תִשְׁגֶּה בְנִי בְזָרָה וּתְחַבֵּק חֵק נָכְרִיָּה׃
verses.english: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of an alien?

verses.hebrew: כִּי נֹכַח עֵינֵי יְהוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ וְכָל־מַעְגְּלֹתָיו מְפַלֵּס׃
verses.english: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he ponders all his goings.

verses.hebrew: עַווֹנוֹתָיו יִלְכְּדֻנוֹ אֶת־הָרָשָׁע וּבְחַבְלֵי חַטָּאתוֹ יִתָּמֵךְ׃
verses.english: His own iniquities shall trap the wicked man, and he shall be caught fast in the cords of his sins.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יָמוּת בְּאֵין מוּסָר וּבְרֹב אִוַּלְתּוֹ יִשְׁגֶּה׃
verses.english: He shall die for want of instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־עָרַבְתָּ לְרֵעֶךָ תָּקַעְתָּ לַזָּר כַּפֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast struck thy palms for a stranger,

verses.hebrew: נוֹקַשְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי־פִיךָ נִלְכַּדְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃
verses.english: if thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, caught with the sayings of thy mouth:

verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה זֹאת אֵפוֹא בְּנִי וְהִנָּצֵל כִּי בָאתָ בְכַף־רֵעֶךָ לֵךְ הִתְרַפֵּס וּרְהַב רֵעֶיךָ׃
verses.english: do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy neighbour; go, abase thyself, and importune thy neighbour.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן שֵׁנָה לְעֵינֶיךָ וּתְנוּמָה לְעַפְעַפֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: Give no sleep to thy eyes, nor slumber to thy eyelids.

verses.hebrew: הִנָּצֵל כִּצְבִי מִיָּד וּכְצִפּוֹר מִיַּד יָקוּשׁ׃
verses.english: Deliver thyself like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, and like a bird from the hand of the fowler.

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ־אֶל־נְמָלָה עָצֵל רְאֵה דְרָכֶיהָ וַחֲכָם׃
verses.english: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהּ קָצִין שֹׁטֵר וּמֹשֵׁל׃
verses.english: which having no guide, overseer, or ruler;

verses.hebrew: תָּכִין בַּקַּיִץ לַחְמָהּ אָגְרָה בַקָּצִיר מַאֲכָלָהּ׃
verses.english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי עָצֵל תִּשְׁכָּב מָתַי תָּקוּם מִשְּׁנָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

verses.hebrew: מְעַט שֵׁנוֹת מְעַט תְּנוּמוֹת מְעַט חִבֻּק יָדַיִם לִשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.hebrew: וּבָא־כִמְהַלֵּךְ רֵאשֶׁךָ וּמַחְסֹרְךָ כְּאִישׁ מָגֵן׃
verses.english: so shall thy poverty come like a marauder, and thy want like an armed man.

verses.hebrew: אָדָם בְּלִיַּעַל אִישׁ אָוֶן הוֹלֵךְ עִקְּשׁוּת פֶּה׃
verses.english: A base person, a wicked man, is one that walks with a crowed mouth,

verses.hebrew: קֹרֵץ בְּעֵינָו מֹלֵל בְּרַגְלָו מֹרֶה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָיו׃
verses.english: that winks with his eyes, that taps with his feet, that points with his fingers;

verses.hebrew: תַּהְפֻּכוֹת בְּלִבּוֹ חֹרֵשׁ רָע בְּכָל־עֵת מדנים [מִדְיָנִים] יְשַׁלֵּחַ׃
verses.english: perverseness is in his heart; he devises mischief continually; he sows discord.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן פִּתְאֹם יָבוֹא אֵידוֹ פֶּתַע יִשָּׁבֵר וְאֵין מַרְפֵּא׃
verses.english: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁשׁ־הֵנָּה שָׂנֵא יְהוָה וְשֶׁבַע תועבות [תּוֹעֲבַת] נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: There are six things which the Lord hates, and seven which are an abomination to him:

verses.hebrew: עֵינַיִם רָמוֹת לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר וְיָדַיִם שֹׁפְכוֹת דָּם־נָקִי׃
verses.english: a proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.hebrew: לֵב חֹרֵשׁ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָוֶן רַגְלַיִם מְמַהֲרוֹת לָרוּץ לָרָעָה׃
verses.english: a heart that devises wicked thoughts, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

verses.hebrew: יָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים עֵד שָׁקֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּחַ מְדָנִים בֵּין אַחִים׃
verses.english: a false witness that breathes out lies, and one that sows discord among brethren.

verses.hebrew: נְצֹר בְּנִי מִצְוַת אָבִיךָ וְאַל־תִּטֹּשׁ תּוֹרַת אִמֶּךָ׃
verses.english: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the Tora of thy mother:

verses.hebrew: קָשְׁרֵם עַל־לִבְּךָ תָמִיד עָנְדֵם עַל־גַּרְגְּרֹתֶךָ׃
verses.english: bind them continually upon thy heart, and tie them about thy neck.

verses.hebrew: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ תַּנְחֶה אֹתָךְ בְּשָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹר עָלֶיךָ וַהֲקִיצוֹתָ הִיא תְשִׂיחֶךָ׃
verses.english: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; when thou liest down, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי נֵר מִצְוָה וְתוֹרָה אוֹר וְדֶרֶךְ חַיִּים תּוֹכְחוֹת מוּסָר׃
verses.english: For the commandment is a lamp; and Tora is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמָרְךָ מֵאֵשֶׁת רָע מֵחֶלְקַת לָשׁוֹן נָכְרִיָּה׃
verses.english: to keep thee from the evil woman, from the smoothness of the tongue of an alien.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּחְמֹד יָפְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ וְאַל־תִּקָּחֲךָ בְּעַפְעַפֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; nor let her take thee with her eyelids.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְעַד־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה עַד־כִּכַּר לָחֶם וְאֵשֶׁת אִישׁ נֶפֶשׁ יְקָרָה תָצוּד׃
verses.english: For by means of a harlot a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

verses.hebrew: הֲיַחְתֶּה אִישׁ אֵשׁ בְּחֵיקוֹ וּבְגָדָיו לֹא תִשָּׂרַפְנָה׃
verses.english: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

verses.hebrew: אִם־יְהַלֵּךְ אִישׁ עַל־הַגֶּחָלִים וְרַגְלָיו לֹא תִכָּוֶינָה׃
verses.english: Can one walk upon hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

verses.hebrew: כֵּן הַבָּא אֶל־אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ לֹא יִנָּקֶה כָּל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהּ׃
verses.english: So he that goes in to his neighbour’s wife; whoever touches her shall not go unpunished.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָבוּזוּ לַגַּנָּב כִּי יִגְנוֹב לְמַלֵּא נַפְשׁוֹ כִּי יִרְעָב׃
verses.english: Do not men despise a thief, even if he steals to satisfy his soul when he is hungry?

verses.hebrew: וְנִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּם שִׁבְעָתָיִם אֶת־כָּל־הוֹן בֵּיתוֹ יִתֵּן׃
verses.english: And if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

verses.hebrew: נֹאֵף אִשָּׁה חֲסַר־לֵב מַשְׁחִית נַפְשׁוֹ הוּא יַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃
verses.english: He who commits adultery with a woman lacks understanding: he who does that destroys his soul.

verses.hebrew: נֶגַע־וְקָלוֹן יִמְצָא וְחֶרְפָּתוֹ לֹא תִמָּחֶה׃
verses.english: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־קִנְאָה חֲמַת־גָּבֶר וְלֹא־יַחְמוֹל בְּיוֹם נָקָם׃
verses.english: For jealousy is the rage of a man: and he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִשָּׂא פְּנֵי כָל־כֹּפֶר וְלֹא־יֹאבֶה כִּי תַרְבֶּה־שֹׁחַד׃
verses.english: He will not regard any ransom; nor will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי שְׁמֹר אֲמָרָי וּמִצְוֺתַי תִּצְפֹּן אִתָּךְ׃
verses.english: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וֶחְיֵה וְתוֹרָתִי כְּאִישׁוֹן עֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Keep my commandments, and live; and my Tora as the apple of thy eye.

verses.hebrew: קָשְׁרֵם עַל־אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ כָּתְבֵם עַל־לוּחַ לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the tablet of thy heart.

verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר לַחָכְמָה אֲחֹתִי אָתְּ וּמֹדָע לַבִּינָה תִקְרָא׃
verses.english: Say to wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁה זָרָה מִנָּכְרִיָּה אֲמָרֶיהָ הֶחֱלִיקָה׃
verses.english: that they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the alien woman who makes smooth her words.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְּחַלּוֹן בֵּיתִי בְּעַד אֶשְׁנַבִּי נִשְׁקָפְתִּי׃
verses.english: For at the window of my house I looked out through my lattice,

verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא בַפְּתָאיִם אָבִינָה בַבָּנִים נַעַר חֲסַר־לֵב׃
verses.english: and beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

verses.hebrew: עֹבֵר בַּשּׁוּק אֵצֶל פִּנָּהּ וְדֶרֶךְ בֵּיתָהּ יִצְעָד׃
verses.english: passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֶשֶׁף־בְּעֶרֶב יוֹם בְּאִישׁוֹן לַיְלָה וַאֲפֵלָה׃
verses.english: in the twilight, in the evening, in the blackness of a dark night:

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִשָּׁה לִקְרָאתוֹ שִׁית זוֹנָה וּנְצֻרַת לֵב׃
verses.english: and, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.

verses.hebrew: הֹמִיָּה הִיא וְסֹרָרֶת בְּבֵיתָהּ לֹא־יִשְׁכְּנוּ רַגְלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: (She is noisy and ungovernable: her feet do not remain in her house:

verses.hebrew: פַּעַם בַּחוּץ פַּעַם בָּרְחֹבוֹת וְאֵצֶל כָּל־פִּנָּה תֶאֱרֹב׃
verses.english: now is she outside, now in the streets, and she lies in wait at every corner.)

verses.hebrew: וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בּוֹ וְנָשְׁקָה־לּוֹ הֵעֵזָה פָנֶיהָ וַתֹּאמַר לוֹ׃
verses.english: So she caught hold of him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said to him,

verses.hebrew: זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים עָלָי הַיּוֹם שִׁלַּמְתִּי נְדָרָי׃
verses.english: I have had to sacrifice peace offerings; this day have I paid my vows.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן יָצָאתִי לִקְרָאתֶךָ לְשַׁחֵר פָּנֶיךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶךָּ׃
verses.english: So I came out to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

verses.hebrew: מַרְבַדִּים רָבַדְתִּי עַרְשִׂי חֲטֻבוֹת אֵטוּן מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: I have decked my bed with coverings, with tapestry of Miżrian yarn.

verses.hebrew: נַפְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִי מֹר אֲהָלִים וְקִנָּמוֹן׃
verses.english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.hebrew: לְכָה נִרְוֶה דֹדִים עַד־הַבֹּקֶר נִתְעַלְּסָה בָּאֳהָבִים׃
verses.english: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us delight ourselves with loves.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין הָאִישׁ בְּבֵיתוֹ הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מֵרָחוֹק׃
verses.english: For my husband is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

verses.hebrew: צְרוֹר־הַכֶּסֶף לָקַח בְּיָדוֹ לְיוֹם הַכֵּסֶא יָבֹא בֵיתוֹ׃
verses.english: he has taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the full moon.

verses.hebrew: הִטַּתּוּ בְּרֹב לִקְחָהּ בְּחֵלֶק שְׂפָתֶיהָ תַּדִּיחֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: With her much fair speech she causes him to yield, with the smoothness of her lips she seduces him.

verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ פִּתְאֹם כְּשׁוֹר אֶל־טָבַח יָבוֹא וּכְעֶכֶס אֶל־מוּסַר אֱוִיל׃
verses.english: He goes after her at once, as an ox goes to the slaughter, and as a man in chains to the chastisement of a fool;

verses.hebrew: עַד יְפַלַּח חֵץ כְּבֵדוֹ כְּמַהֵר צִפּוֹר אֶל־פָּח וְלֹא־יָדַע כִּי־בְנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא׃
verses.english: till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hastens to the snare, and knows not that it is for his life.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃
verses.english: Hearken to me now therefore, O you children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יֵשְׂטְ אֶל־דְּרָכֶיהָ לִבֶּךָ אַל־תֵּתַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Let not thy heart decline to her ways, do not go astray in her paths.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־רַבִּים חֲלָלִים הִפִּילָה וַעֲצֻמִים כָּל־הֲרֻגֶיהָ׃
verses.english: For she has cast down many wounded: and many strong men have been slain by her.

verses.hebrew: דַּרְכֵי שְׁאוֹל בֵּיתָהּ יֹרְדוֹת אֶל־חַדְרֵי־מָוֶת׃
verses.english: Her house is the way to She᾽ol, going down to the chambers of death.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־חָכְמָה תִקְרָא וּתְבוּנָה תִּתֵּן קוֹלָהּ׃
verses.english: Does not wisdom call? and understanding put forth her voice?

verses.hebrew: בְּרֹאשׁ־מְרוֹמִים עֲלֵי־דָרֶךְ בֵּית נְתִיבוֹת נִצָּבָה׃
verses.english: She stands at the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet.

verses.hebrew: לְיַד־שְׁעָרִים לְפִי־קָרֶת מְבוֹא פְתָחִים תָּרֹנָּה׃
verses.english: She cries out at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in of the doors.

verses.hebrew: אֲלֵיכֶם אִישִׁים אֶקְרָא וְקוֹלִי אֶל־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: To you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

verses.hebrew: הָבִינוּ פְתָאיִם עָרְמָה וּכְסִילִים הָבִינוּ לֵב׃
verses.english: O you simple, understand prudence: and, you fools, be of an understanding heart.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ כִּי־נְגִידִים אֲדַבֵּר וּמִפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי מֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: Hear; for I will speak excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be rectitude.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֱמֶת יֶהְגֶּה חִכִּי וְתוֹעֲבַת שְׂפָתַי רֶשַׁע׃
verses.english: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.hebrew: בְּצֶדֶק כָּל־אִמְרֵי־פִי אֵין בָּהֶם נִפְתָּל וְעִקֵּשׁ׃
verses.english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם נְכֹחִים לַמֵּבִין וִישָׁרִים לְמֹצְאֵי דָעַת׃
verses.english: They are all plain to him that understands, and right to those who find knowledge.

verses.hebrew: קְחוּ־מוּסָרִי וְאַל־כָּסֶף וְדַעַת מֵחָרוּץ נִבְחָר׃
verses.english: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־טוֹבָה חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים וְכָל־חֲפָצִים לֹא יִשְׁווּ־בָהּ׃
verses.english: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־חָכְמָה שָׁכַנְתִּי עָרְמָה וְדַעַת מְזִמּוֹת אֶמְצָא׃
verses.english: I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, and find knowledge and discretion.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה שְׂנֹאת רָע גֵּאָה וְגָאוֹן וְדֶרֶךְ רָע וּפִי תַהְפֻּכוֹת שָׂנֵאתִי׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the sly mouth I hate.

verses.hebrew: לִי־עֵצָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה אֲנִי בִינָה לִי גְבוּרָה׃
verses.english: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

verses.hebrew: בִּי מְלָכִים יִמְלֹכוּ וְרוֹזְנִים יְחֹקְקוּ צֶדֶק׃
verses.english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

verses.hebrew: בִּי שָׂרִים יָשֹׂרוּ וּנְדִיבִים כָּל־שֹׁפְטֵי צֶדֶק׃
verses.english: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אהביה [אֹהֲבַי] אֵהָב וּמְשַׁחֲרַי יִמְצָאֻנְנִי׃
verses.english: I love those who love me; and those who seek me early shall find me.

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׁר־וְכָבוֹד אִתִּי הוֹן עָתֵק וּצְדָקָה׃
verses.english: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב פִּרְיִי מֵחָרוּץ וּמִפָּז וּתְבוּאָתִי מִכֶּסֶף נִבְחָר׃
verses.english: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my produce than choice silver.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרַח־צְדָקָה אֲהַלֵּך בְּתוֹךְ נְתִיבוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of justice:

verses.hebrew: לְהַנְחִיל אֹהֲבַי יֵשׁ וְאֹצְרֹתֵיהֶם אֲמַלֵּא׃
verses.english: That I may cause those who love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה קָנָנִי רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכּוֹ קֶדֶם מִפְעָלָיו מֵאָז׃
verses.english: The Lord created me as the beginning of his way, the first of his works of old.

verses.hebrew: מֵעוֹלָם נִסַּכְתִּי מֵרֹאשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before ever the earth was.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין־תְּהֹמוֹת חוֹלָלְתִּי בְּאֵין מַעְיָנוֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־מָיִם׃
verses.english: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים הָטְבָּעוּ לִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָלְתִּי׃
verses.english: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

verses.hebrew: עַד־לֹא עָשָׂה אֶרֶץ וְחוּצוֹת וְרֹאשׁ עָפְרוֹת תֵּבֵל׃
verses.english: while as yet he had not made the earth, or the fields, or the highest part of the dust of the world.

verses.hebrew: בַּהֲכִינוֹ שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָנִי בְּחוּקוֹ חוּג עַל־פְּנֵי תְהוֹם׃
verses.english: When he established the heavens, I was there: when he drew a circle over the surface of the deep:

verses.hebrew: בְּאַמְּצוֹ שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל בַּעֲזוֹז עִינוֹת תְּהוֹם׃
verses.english: when he established the clouds above: when the fountains of the deep became strong:

verses.hebrew: בְּשׂוּמוֹ לַיָּם חֻקּוֹ וּמַיִם לֹא יַעַבְרוּ־פִיו בְּחוּקוֹ מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: when he gave to the sea its decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

verses.hebrew: וָאֶהְיֶה אֶצְלוֹ אָמוֹן וָאֶהְיֶה שַׁעֲשֻׁעִים יוֹם יוֹם מְשַׂחֶקֶת לְפָנָיו בְּכָל־עֵת׃
verses.english: then I was by him, as a nurseling: and I was daily his delight, playing always before him;

verses.hebrew: מְשַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵל אַרְצוֹ וְשַׁעֲשֻׁעַי אֶת־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: playing with the universe, his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי וְאַשְׁרֵי דְּרָכַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ׃
verses.english: Now therefore hearken to me, O you children: for happy are they who keep my ways.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ מוּסָר וַחֲכָמוּ וְאַל־תִּפְרָעוּ׃
verses.english: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי לִשְׁקֹד עַל־דַּלְתֹתַי יוֹם יוֹם לִשְׁמֹר מְזוּזֹת פְּתָחָי׃
verses.english: Happy is the man who hearkens to me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מֹצְאִי מצאי [מָצָא] חַיִּים וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה׃
verses.english: For whoever finds me finds life, and obtains favour of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: וְחֹטְאִי חֹמֵס נַפְשׁוֹ כָּל־מְשַׂנְאַי אָהֲבוּ מָוֶת׃
verses.english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul: all they who hate me love death.

verses.hebrew: חָכְמוֹת בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ חָצְבָה עַמּוּדֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה׃
verses.english: Wisdom has built her house, she has hewn out her seven pillars:

verses.hebrew: טָבְחָה טִבְחָהּ מָסְכָה יֵינָהּ אַף עָרְכָה שֻׁלְחָנָהּ׃
verses.english: she has killed her beasts; she has mingled her wine; she has also furnished her table.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלְחָה נַעֲרֹתֶיהָ תִקְרָא עַל־גַּפֵּי מְרֹמֵי קָרֶת׃
verses.english: She has sent forth her maidens: she calls upon the highest places of the city, Whoever is simple, let him turn in here:

verses.hebrew: מִי־פֶתִי יָסֻר הֵנָּה חֲסַר־לֵב אָמְרָה לּוֹ׃
verses.english: as for him that lacks understanding, she says to him,

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ לַחֲמוּ בְלַחֲמִי וּשְׁתוּ בְּיַיִן מָסָכְתִּי׃
verses.english: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

verses.hebrew: עִזְבוּ פְתָאיִם וִחְיוּ וְאִשְׁרוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ בִּינָה׃
verses.english: Forsake foolishness, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

verses.hebrew: יֹסֵר לֵץ לֹקֵחַ לוֹ קָלוֹן וּמוֹכִיחַ לְרָשָׁע מוּמוֹ׃
verses.english: He who corrects a scorner brings shame on himself: and he who rebukes a wicked man brings on himself his blemish.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תּוֹכַח לֵץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶךָּ הוֹכַח לְחָכָם וְיֶאֱהָבֶךָּ׃
verses.english: Do not reprove a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

verses.hebrew: תֵּן לְחָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־עוֹד הוֹדַע לְצַדִּיק וְיוֹסֶף לֶקַח׃
verses.english: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

verses.hebrew: תְּחִלַּת חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה וְדַעַת קְדֹשִׁים בִּינָה׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of holy matters is understanding.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בִי יִרְבּוּ יָמֶיךָ וְיוֹסִיפוּ לְּךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּים׃
verses.english: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

verses.hebrew: אִם־חָכַמְתָּ חָכַמְתָּ לָּךְ וְלַצְתָּ לְבַדְּךָ תִשָּׂא׃
verses.english: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself: and if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

verses.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת כְּסִילוּת הֹמִיָּה פְּתַיּוּת וּבַל־יָדְעָה מָּה׃
verses.english: The woman Folly is clamorous: she is simple, and knows nothing.

verses.hebrew: וְיָשְׁבָה לְפֶתַח בֵּיתָהּ עַל־כִּסֵּא מְרֹמֵי קָרֶת׃
verses.english: For she sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city.

verses.hebrew: לִקְרֹא לְעֹבְרֵי־דָרֶךְ הַמְיַשְּׁרִים אֹרְחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Calling out to passers by who are going straight on their ways:

verses.hebrew: מִי־פֶתִי יָסֻר הֵנָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵב וְאָמְרָה לּוֹ׃
verses.english: Whoever is simple, let him turn in here: and as for him that lacks understanding, she says to him,

verses.hebrew: מַיִם־גְּנוּבִים יִמְתָּקוּ וְלֶחֶם סְתָרִים יִנְעָם׃
verses.english: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָדַע כִּי־רְפָאִים שָׁם בְּעִמְקֵי שְׁאוֹל קְרֻאֶיהָ׃
verses.english: But he knows not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָב וּבֵן כְּסִיל תּוּגַת אִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: The proverbs of Shelomo. A wise son makes a glad father: but a foolish son is the grief of his mother.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יוֹעִילוּ אוֹצְרוֹת רֶשַׁע וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּוֶת׃
verses.english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַרְעִיב יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְהַוַּת רְשָׁעִים יֶהְדֹּף׃
verses.english: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: רָאשׁ עֹשֶׂה כַף־רְמִיָּה וְיַד חָרוּצִים תַּעֲשִׁיר׃
verses.english: A slack hand causes poverty: but the hand of the diligent makes rich.

verses.hebrew: אֹגֵר בַּקַּיִץ בֵּן מַשְׂכִּיל נִרְדָּם בַּקָּצִיר בֵּן מֵבִישׁ׃
verses.english: He that gathers in summer is a wise son: but a son that sleeps in harvest brings shame.

verses.hebrew: בְּרָכוֹת לְרֹאשׁ צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָס׃
verses.english: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה וְשֵׁם רְשָׁעִים יִרְקָב׃
verses.english: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

verses.hebrew: חֲכַם־לֵב יִקַּח מִצְוֺת וֶאֱוִיל שְׂפָתַיִם יִלָּבֵט׃
verses.english: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall be punished.

verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ בַּתֹּם יֵלֶךְ בֶּטַח וּמְעַקֵּשׁ דְּרָכָיו יִוָּדֵעַ׃
verses.english: He that walks uprightly walks surely: but he that perverts his ways shall be found out.

verses.hebrew: קֹרֵץ עַיִן יִתֵּן עַצָּבֶת וֶאֱוִיל שְׂפָתַיִם יִלָּבֵט׃
verses.english: He that winks with the eye causes sorrow: and a prating fool shall fall.

verses.hebrew: מְקוֹר חַיִּים פִּי צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָס׃
verses.english: The mouth of a righteous man is a fountain of life: but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: שִׂנְאָה תְּעוֹרֵר מְדָנִים וְעַל כָּל־פְּשָׁעִים תְּכַסֶּה אַהֲבָה׃
verses.english: Hatred stirs up strifes: but love covers all sins.

verses.hebrew: בְּשִׂפְתֵי נָבוֹן תִּמָּצֵא חָכְמָה וְשֵׁבֶט לְגֵו חֲסַר־לֵב׃
verses.english: In the lips of him that has understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

verses.hebrew: חֲכָמִים יִצְפְּנוּ־דָעַת וּפִי־אֱוִיל מְחִתָּה קְרֹבָה׃
verses.english: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the fool brings ruin near.

verses.hebrew: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ מְחִתַּת דַּלִּים רֵישָׁם׃
verses.english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the ruin of the poor is their poverty.

verses.hebrew: פְּעֻלַּת צַדִּיק לְחַיִּים תְּבוּאַת רָשָׁע לְחַטָּאת׃
verses.english: The wage of the righteous brings life: the gain of the wicked leads to sin.

verses.hebrew: אֹרַח לְחַיִּים שׁוֹמֵר מוּסָר וְעוֹזֵב תּוֹכַחַת מַתְעֶה׃
verses.english: He that keeps instruction is in the way of life: but he that refuses reproof leads astray.

verses.hebrew: מְכַסֶּה שִׂנְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁקֶר וּמוֹצִא דִבָּה הוּא כְסִיל׃
verses.english: He who hides hatred uses lying lips, and he that utters a slander, is a fool.

verses.hebrew: בְּרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֶחְדַּל־פָּשַׁע וְחֹשֵׂךְ שְׂפָתָיו מַשְׂכִּיל׃
verses.english: In the multitude of words sin is not lacking: but he who restrains his lips is wise.

verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף נִבְחָר לְשׁוֹן צַדִּיק לֵב רְשָׁעִים כִּמְעָט׃
verses.english: The tongue of the just is like choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יִרְעוּ רַבִּים וֶאֱוִילִים בַּחֲסַר־לֵב יָמוּתוּ׃
verses.english: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

verses.hebrew: בִּרְכַּת יְהוָה הִיא תַעֲשִׁיר וְלֹא־יוֹסִף עֶצֶב עִמָּהּ׃
verses.english: The blessing of the Lord, it makes rich, and he adds no sorrow with it.

verses.hebrew: כִּשְׂחוֹק לִכְסִיל עֲשׂוֹת זִמָּה וְחָכְמָה לְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה׃
verses.english: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: and likewise is it to a man of understanding to practise wisdom.

verses.hebrew: מְגוֹרַת רָשָׁע הִיא תְבוֹאֶנּוּ וְתַאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּן׃
verses.english: What the wicked dreads shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

verses.hebrew: כַּעֲבוֹר סוּפָה וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְצַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: When the storm wind passes, the wicked is no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

verses.hebrew: כַּחֹמֶץ לַשִּׁנַּיִם וְכֶעָשָׁן לָעֵינָיִם כֵּן הֶעָצֵל לְשֹׁלְחָיו׃
verses.english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה תּוֹסִיף יָמִים וּשְׁנוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּקְצֹרְנָה׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord prolongs days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹחֶלֶת צַדִּיקִים שִׂמְחָה וְתִקְוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃
verses.english: The hope of the righteous is gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

verses.hebrew: מָעוֹז לַתֹּם דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: The way of the Lord is a stronghold to the upright, but destruction to the workers of iniquity.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק לְעוֹלָם בַּל־יִמּוֹט וּרְשָׁעִים לֹא יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

verses.hebrew: פִּי־צַדִּיק יָנוּב חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹן תַּהְפֻּכוֹת תִּכָּרֵת׃
verses.english: The mouth of the just brings forth wisdom: but the perverse tongue shall be cut off.

verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יֵדְעוּן רָצוֹן וּפִי רְשָׁעִים תַּהְפֻּכוֹת׃
verses.english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked is crookedness.

verses.hebrew: מֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וְאֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה רְצוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: but a just weight is his delight.

verses.hebrew: בָּא־זָדוֹן וַיָּבֹא קָלוֹן וְאֶת־צְנוּעִים חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: When pride comes, then comes shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

verses.hebrew: תֻּמַּת יְשָׁרִים תַּנְחֵם וְסֶלֶף בּוֹגְדִים ושדם [יְשָׁדֵּם׃]
verses.english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of the faithless shall destroy them.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יוֹעִיל הוֹן בְּיוֹם עֶבְרָה וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּוֶת׃
verses.english: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.hebrew: צִדְקַת תָּמִים תְּיַשֵּׁר דַּרְכּוֹ וּבְרִשְׁעָתוֹ יִפֹּל רָשָׁע׃
verses.english: The righteousness of the innocent shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

verses.hebrew: צִדְקַת יְשָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵם וּבְהַוַּת בֹּגְדִים יִלָּכֵדוּ׃
verses.english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but the faithless shall be caught in their own malice.

verses.hebrew: בְּמוֹת אָדָם רָשָׁע תֹּאבַד תִּקְוָה וְתוֹחֶלֶת אוֹנִים אָבָדָה׃
verses.english: When a wicked man dies, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perishes.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק מִצָּרָה נֶחֱלָץ וַיָּבֹא רָשָׁע תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes in his stead.

verses.hebrew: בְּפֶה חָנֵף יַשְׁחִת רֵעֵהוּ וּבְדַעַת צַדִּיקִים יֵחָלֵצוּ׃
verses.english: A hypocrite destroys his neighbour with his mouth: but the just shall be delivered through knowledge.

verses.hebrew: בְּטוּב צַדִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹץ קִרְיָה וּבַאֲבֹד רְשָׁעִים רִנָּה׃
verses.english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices: but when the wicked perish, there is jubilation.

verses.hebrew: בְּבִרְכַּת יְשָׁרִים תָּרוּם קָרֶת וּבְפִי רְשָׁעִים תֵּהָרֵס׃
verses.english: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: בָּז־לְרֵעֵהוּ חֲסַר־לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנוֹת יַחֲרִישׁ׃
verses.english: He that is void of wisdom despises his neighbour: but a man of understanding holds his peace.

verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ רָכִיל מְגַלֶּה־סּוֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־רוּחַ מְכַסֶּה דָבָר׃
verses.english: A talebearer reveals secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit conceals the matter.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין תַּחְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל־עָם וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵץ׃
verses.english: Where there is no counsel, a people falls: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.hebrew: רַע־יֵרוֹעַ כִּי־עָרַב זָר וְשֹׂנֵא תֹקְעִים בּוֹטֵחַ׃
verses.english: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: but he that hates suretyship is safe.

verses.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת־חֵן תִּתְמֹךְ כָּבוֹד וְעָרִיצִים יִתְמְכוּ־עֹשֶׁר׃
verses.english: A woman of charm obtains honour: and powerful men obtain wealth.

verses.hebrew: גֹּמֵל נַפְשׁוֹ אִישׁ חָסֶד וְעֹכֵר שְׁאֵרוֹ אַכְזָרִי׃
verses.english: The merciful man does good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubles his own flesh.

verses.hebrew: רָשָׁע עֹשֶׂה פְעֻלַּת־שָׁקֶר וְזֹרֵעַ צְדָקָה שֶׂכֶר אֱמֶת׃
verses.english: The wicked man earns wages of deceit: but he that sows righteousness has a sure reward.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן־צְדָקָה לְחַיִּים וּמְרַדֵּף רָעָה לְמוֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: He that is firm in righteousness achieves life; but he that pursues evil comes to his own death.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵב וּרְצוֹנוֹ תְּמִימֵי דָרֶךְ׃
verses.english: They that are of a crooked heart are an abomination to the Lord: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

verses.hebrew: יָד לְיָד לֹא־יִנָּקֶה רָּע וְזֶרַע צַדִּיקִים נִמְלָט׃
verses.english: They who join hands for wicked ends shall not go unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

verses.hebrew: נֶזֶם זָהָב בְּאַף חֲזִיר אִשָּׁה יָפָה וְסָרַת טָעַם׃
verses.english: Like a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman without discretion.

verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים אַךְ־טוֹב תִּקְוַת רְשָׁעִים עֶבְרָה׃
verses.english: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ מְפַזֵּר וְנוֹסָף עוֹד וְחוֹשֵׂךְ מִיֹּשֶׁר אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר׃
verses.english: There is one who gives freely, and yet increases, another spares unjustly, but comes to want.

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ־בְּרָכָה תְדֻשָּׁן וּמַרְוֶה גַּם־הוּא יוֹרֶא׃
verses.english: The liberal soul shall be made rich: and he who waters shall be nourished also himself.

verses.hebrew: מֹנֵעַ בָּר יִקְּבֻהוּ לְאוֹם וּבְרָכָה לְרֹאשׁ מַשְׁבִּיר׃
verses.english: He who holds back corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him who sells freely.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁחֵר טוֹב יְבַקֵּשׁ רָצוֹן וְדֹרֵשׁ רָעָה תְבוֹאֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: He who diligently seeks good procures favour: but he who seeks mischief, it shall come to him.

verses.hebrew: בּוֹטֵחַ בְּעָשְׁרוֹ הוּא יִפֹּל וְכֶעָלֶה צַדִּיקִים יִפְרָחוּ׃
verses.english: He who trusts in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish like foliage.

verses.hebrew: עוֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ יִנְחַל־רוּחַ וְעֶבֶד אֱוִיל לַחֲכַם־לֵב׃
verses.english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

verses.hebrew: פְּרִי־צַדִּיק עֵץ חַיִּים וְלֹקֵחַ נְפָשׂוֹת חָכָם׃
verses.english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that wins souls is wise.

verses.hebrew: הֵן צַדִּיק בָּאָרֶץ יְשֻׁלָּם אַף כִּי־רָשָׁע וְחוֹטֵא׃
verses.english: Behold, the just man shall be recompensed on earth: how much more the wicked and the sinner!

verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב מוּסָר אֹהֵב דָּעַת וְשֹׂנֵא תוֹכַחַת בָּעַר׃
verses.english: Whoever loves knowledge loves discipline: but he who hates reproof is stupid.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב יָפִיק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יַרְשִׁיעַ׃
verses.english: A good man obtains favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִכּוֹן אָדָם בְּרֶשַׁע וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃
verses.english: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

verses.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת־חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ וּכְרָקָב בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו מְבִישָׁה׃
verses.english: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that acts shamefully is as rottenness in his bones.

verses.hebrew: מַחְשְׁבוֹת צַדִּיקִים מִשְׁפָּט תַּחְבֻּלוֹת רְשָׁעִים מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי רְשָׁעִים אֱרָב־דָּם וּפִי יְשָׁרִים יַצִּילֵם׃
verses.english: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

verses.hebrew: הָפוֹךְ רְשָׁעִים וְאֵינָם וּבֵית צַדִּיקִים יַעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

verses.hebrew: לְפִי־שִׂכְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵב יִהְיֶה לָבוּז׃
verses.english: A man shall be commended according to his intelligence: but he that is of perverse mind shall be despised.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב נִקְלֶה וְעֶבֶד לוֹ מִמְּתַכַּבֵּד וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Better is one lightly esteemed who owns a servant, than one who pranks himself but lacks bread.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְרַחֲמֵי רְשָׁעִים אַכְזָרִי׃
verses.english: A righteous man regards the life of his beast: but the heart of the wicked is cruel.

verses.hebrew: עֹבֵד אַדְמָתוֹ יִשְׂבַּע־לָחֶם וּמְרַדֵּף רֵיקִים חֲסַר־לֵב׃
verses.english: He that tills his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that follows vain persons is void of understanding.

verses.hebrew: חָמַד רָשָׁע מְצוֹד רָעִים וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּן׃
verses.english: The wicked man craves – he is snared by mischief: but the righteous strike root.

verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע שְׂפָתַיִם מוֹקֵשׁ רָע וַיֵּצֵא מִצָּרָה צַדִּיק׃
verses.english: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

verses.hebrew: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־טוֹב וּגְמוּל יְדֵי־אָדָם ישוב [יָשִׁיב] לוֹ׃
verses.english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompense of a man’s hands shall be rendered to him.

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ אֱוִיל יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְשֹׁמֵעַ לְעֵצָה חָכָם׃
verses.english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkens unto counsel is wise.

verses.hebrew: אֱוִיל בַּיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כַּעְסוֹ וְכֹסֶה קָלוֹן עָרוּם׃
verses.english: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man conceals disgrace.

verses.hebrew: יָפִיחַ אֱמוּנָה יַגִּיד צֶדֶק וְעֵד שְׁקָרִים מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: He who utters truth gives just evidence: but a false witness utters deceit.

verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ בּוֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְרוֹת חָרֶב וּלְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים מַרְפֵּא׃
verses.english: There is one who speaks like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

verses.hebrew: שְׂפַת־אֱמֶת תִּכּוֹן לָעַד וְעַד־אַרְגִּיעָה לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

verses.hebrew: מִרְמָה בְּלֶב־חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וּלְיֹעֲצֵי שָׁלוֹם שִׂמְחָה׃
verses.english: Deceit is in the heart of those who imagine evil: but the counsellors of peace have joy.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יְאֻנֶּה לַצַּדִּיק כָּל־אָוֶן וּרְשָׁעִים מָלְאוּ רָע׃
verses.english: No evil shall happen to the just: but the wicked are filled with mischief.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁקֶר וְעֹשֵׂי אֱמוּנָה רְצוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they who deal truly are his delight.

verses.hebrew: אָדָם עָרוּם כֹּסֶה דָּעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים יִקְרָא אִוֶּלֶת׃
verses.english: A prudent man conceals knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaims his foolishness.

verses.hebrew: יַד־חָרוּצִים תִּמְשׁוֹל ורְמִיָּה תִּהְיֶה לָמַס׃
verses.english: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

verses.hebrew: דְּאָגָה בְלֶב־אִישׁ יַשְׁחֶנָּה וְדָבָר טוֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶנָּה׃
verses.english: Anxiety in a man’s heart dejects it: but a good word gladdens it.

verses.hebrew: יָתֵר מֵרֵעֵהוּ צַדִּיק וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּתְעֵם׃
verses.english: The righteous guides his neighbour aright: but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַחֲרֹךְ רְמִיָּה צֵידוֹ וְהוֹן־אָדָם יָקָר חָרוּץ׃
verses.english: The slothful man does not roast his catch: but the industrious man arrives at precious wealth.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרַח־צְדָקָה חַיִּים וְדֶרֶךְ נְתִיבָה אַל־מָוֶת׃
verses.english: In the way of righteousness is life; and in its path there is no death.

verses.hebrew: בֵּן חָכָם מוּסַר אָב וְלֵץ לֹא־שָׁמַע גְּעָרָה׃
verses.english: A wise son hears his father’s instruction: but a scorner does not accept rebuke.

verses.hebrew: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ יֹאכַל טוֹב וְנֶפֶשׁ בֹּגְדִים חָמָס׃
verses.english: A man shall eat good from the fruit of his mouth: but the desire of the faithless is for violence.

verses.hebrew: נֹצֵר פִּיו שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ פֹּשֵׂק שְׂפָתָיו מְחִתָּה־לוֹ׃
verses.english: He who guards his mouth keeps his life: but he who opens wide his lips shall have destruction.

verses.hebrew: מִתְאַוָּה וָאַיִן נַפְשׁוֹ עָצֵל וְנֶפֶשׁ חָרֻצִים תְּדֻשָּׁן׃
verses.english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be richly supplied.

verses.hebrew: דְּבַר־שֶׁקֶר יִשְׂנָא צַדִּיק וְרָשָׁע יַבְאִישׁ וְיַחְפִּיר׃
verses.english: A righteous man hates lying: but a wicked man is vile, and comes to shame.

verses.hebrew: צְדָקָה תִּצֹּר תָּם־דָּרֶךְ וְרִשְׁעָה תְּסַלֵּף חַטָּאת׃
verses.english: Righteousness keeps him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ מִתְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵין כֹּל מִתְרוֹשֵׁשׁ וְהוֹן רָב׃
verses.english: There is one who pretends to be rich, yet has nothing: there is another who pretends to be poor, yet has great riches.

verses.hebrew: כֹּפֶר נֶפֶשׁ־אִישׁ עָשְׁרוֹ וְרָשׁ לֹא־שָׁמַע גְּעָרָה׃
verses.english: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor hears no threat.

verses.hebrew: אוֹר־צַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמָח וְנֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ׃
verses.english: The light of the righteous rejoices: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.hebrew: רַק־בְּזָדוֹן יִתֵּן מַצָּה וְאֶת־נוֹעָצִים חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: Only by pride comes contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

verses.hebrew: הוֹן מֵהֶבֶל יִמְעָט וְקֹבֵץ עַל־יָד יַרְבֶּה׃
verses.english: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathers by labour shall increase.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹחֶלֶת מְמֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה־לֵב וְעֵץ חַיִּים תַּאֲוָה בָאָה׃
verses.english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick: but desire fulfilled is a tree of life.

verses.hebrew: בָּז לְדָבָר יֵחָבֶל לוֹ וִירֵא מִצְוָה הוּא יְשֻׁלָּם׃
verses.english: He who despises the word shall be punished; but he who fears the commandment shall be rewarded.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹרַת חָכָם מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃
verses.english: The Tora of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.hebrew: שֵׂכֶל־טוֹב יִתֶּן־חֵן וְדֶרֶךְ בֹּגְדִים אֵיתָן׃
verses.english: Good understanding gives grace: but the way of the faithless is rough.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־עָרוּם יַעֲשֶׂה בְדָעַת וּכְסִיל יִפְרֹשׂ אִוֶּלֶת׃
verses.english: In everything a prudent man acts with knowledge: but a fool lays bare his folly.

verses.hebrew: מַלְאָךְ רָשָׁע יִפֹּל בְּרָע וְצִיר אֱמוּנִים מַרְפֵּא׃
verses.english: A wicked messenger falls into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

verses.hebrew: רֵישׁ וְקָלוֹן פּוֹרֵעַ מוּסָר וְשׁוֹמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יְכֻבָּד׃
verses.english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses instruction: but he who heeds reproof shall be honoured.

verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוָה נִהְיָה תֶּעֱרַב לְנָפֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַת כְּסִילִים סוּר מֵרָע׃
verses.english: A desire subdued is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

verses.hebrew: הלוך [הוֹלֵךְ] אֶת־חֲכָמִים וחכם [יֶחְכָּם] וְרֹעֶה כְסִילִים יֵרוֹעַ׃
verses.english: He that walks with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall suffer harm.

verses.hebrew: חַטָּאִים תְּרַדֵּף רָעָה וְאֶת־צַדִּיקִים יְשַׁלֶּם־טוֹב׃
verses.english: Evil pursues sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repaid.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב יַנְחִיל בְּנֵי־בָנִים וְצָפוּן לַצַּדִּיק חֵיל חוֹטֵא׃
verses.english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children: but the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

verses.hebrew: רָב־אֹכֶל נִיר רָאשִׁים וְיֵשׁ נִסְפֶּה בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: Much food is in the well tilled acre of the poor: but sometimes ruin comes for want of judgment.

verses.hebrew: חוֹשֵׂךְ שִׁבְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵא בְנוֹ וְאֹהֲבוֹ שִׁחֲרוֹ מוּסָר׃
verses.english: He that spares his rod hates his son: but he that loves him chastises him early.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק אֹכֵל לְשֹׂבַע נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֶטֶן רְשָׁעִים תֶּחְסָר׃
verses.english: The righteous eats to satisfy his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall feel want.

verses.hebrew: חַכְמוֹת נָשִׁים בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ וְאִוֶּלֶת בְּיָדֶיהָ תֶהֶרְסֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: The wisdom of women builds her house: but Folly plucks it down with her hands.

verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ בְּיָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵא יְהוָה וּנְלוֹז דְּרָכָיו בּוֹזֵהוּ׃
verses.english: He who walks in his uprightness fears the Lord: but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

verses.hebrew: בְּפִי־אֱוִיל חֹטֶר גַּאֲוָה וְשִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים תִּשְׁמוּרֵם׃
verses.english: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין אֲלָפִים אֵבוּס בָּר וְרָב־תְּבוּאוֹת בְּכֹחַ שׁוֹר׃
verses.english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase comes by the strength of the ox.

verses.hebrew: עֵד אֱמוּנִים לֹא יְכַזֵּב וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים עֵד שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: A trusty witness is he that does not lie: but he that utters lies is a false witness.

verses.hebrew: בִּקֶּשׁ־לֵץ חָכְמָה וָאָיִן וְדַעַת לְנָבוֹן נָקָל׃
verses.english: A scorner seeks wisdom, and does not find it: but knowledge is easy to him who understands.

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ מִנֶּגֶד לְאִישׁ כְּסִיל וּבַל־יָדַעְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי־דָעַת׃
verses.english: Go from the presence of a foolish man, for thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

verses.hebrew: חָכְמַת עָרוּם הָבִין דַּרְכּוֹ וְאִוֶּלֶת כְּסִילִים מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

verses.hebrew: אֱוִלִים יָלִיץ אָשָׁם וּבֵין יְשָׁרִים רָצוֹן׃
verses.english: Guilt mocks fools: but the favour of God is among the upright.

verses.hebrew: לֵב יוֹדֵעַ מָרַּת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבְשִׂמְחָתוֹ לֹא־יִתְעָרַב זָר׃
verses.english: The heart knows its own bitterness; and no stranger shares its joy.

verses.hebrew: בֵּית רְשָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵד וְאֹהֶל יְשָׁרִים יַפְרִיחַ׃
verses.english: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tent of the upright shall flourish.

verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי־מָוֶת׃
verses.english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but at its end are the ways of death.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־בִּשְׂחוֹק יִכְאַב־לֵב וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ שִׂמְחָה תוּגָה׃
verses.english: Even in laughter the heart aches: and the end of that mirth is grief.

verses.hebrew: מִדְּרָכָיו יִשְׂבַּע סוּג לֵב וּמֵעָלָיו אִישׁ טוֹב׃
verses.english: The dissembler shall have enough of his own ways: but a good man shall find satisfaction in himself.

verses.hebrew: פֶּתִי יַאֲמִין לְכָל־דָּבָר וְעָרוּם יָבִין לַאֲשֻׁרוֹ׃
verses.english: The simple man believes everything: but the prudent man looks well to his step.

verses.hebrew: חָכָם יָרֵא וְסָר מֵרָע וּכְסִיל מִתְעַבֵּר וּבוֹטֵחַ׃
verses.english: A wise man fears, and departs from evil: but the fool rages, and is confident.

verses.hebrew: קְצַר־אַפַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂה אִוֶּלֶת וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יִשָּׂנֵא׃
verses.english: He that is soon angry acts foolishly: but a man of wicked devices is hated.

verses.hebrew: נָחֲלוּ פְתָאיִם אִוֶּלֶת וַעֲרוּמִים יַכְתִּרוּ דָעַת׃
verses.english: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.hebrew: שַׁחוּ רָעִים לִפְנֵי טוֹבִים וּרְשָׁעִים עַל־שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּיק׃
verses.english: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־לְרֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂנֵא רָשׁ וְאֹהֲבֵי עָשִׁיר רַבִּים׃
verses.english: The poor man is hated even by his own neighbour: but the rich has many friends.

verses.hebrew: בָּז־לְרֵעֵהוּ חוֹטֵא וּמְחוֹנֵן עניים [עֲנָוִים] אַשְׁרָיו׃
verses.english: He that despises his neighbour sins: but he that is kind to the poor, happy is he.

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍לוֹא־יִתְעוּ חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וְחֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת חֹרְשֵׁי טוֹב׃
verses.english: Do not they who devise evil go astray? and do not they who devise good enjoy loyalty and truth?

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־עֶצֶב יִהְיֶה מוֹתָר וּדְבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר׃
verses.english: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tends only to penury.

verses.hebrew: עֲטֶרֶת חֲכָמִים עָשְׁרָם אִוֶּלֶת כְּסִילִים אִוֶּלֶת׃
verses.english: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

verses.hebrew: מַצִּיל נְפָשׁוֹת עֵד אֱמֶת וְיָפִחַ כְּזָבִים מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: A true witness saves lives: but a deceitful witness utters lies.

verses.hebrew: בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מִבְטַח־עֹז וּלְבָנָיו יִהְיֶה מַחְסֶה׃
verses.english: In the fear of the Lord a man has strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.hebrew: בְּרָב־עָם הַדְרַת־מֶלֶךְ וּבְאֶפֶס לְאֹם מְחִתַּת רָזוֹן׃
verses.english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory: but in the lack of people is the downfall of the prince.

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם רַב־תְּבוּנָה וּקְצַר־רוּחַ מֵרִים אִוֶּלֶת׃
verses.english: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalts folly.

verses.hebrew: חַיֵּי בְשָׂרִים לֵב מַרְפֵּא וּרְקַב עֲצָמוֹת קִנְאָה׃
verses.english: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy is the rottenness of the bones.

verses.hebrew: עֹשֵׁק־דָּל חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ וּמְכַבְּדוֹ חֹנֵן אֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: He that oppresses the poor blasphemes his maker: but he that honours him is gracious to the poor.

verses.hebrew: בְּרָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶה רָשָׁע וְחֹסֶה בְמוֹתוֹ צַדִּיק׃
verses.english: The wicked is thrust down in his calamity: but the righteous has hope in his death.

verses.hebrew: בְּלֵב נָבוֹן תָּנוּחַ חָכְמָה וּבְקֶרֶב כְּסִילִים תִּוָּדֵעַ׃
verses.english: Wisdom rests quietly in the heart of the judicious: but the folly in the breast of fools shall easily be known.

verses.hebrew: צְדָקָה תְרוֹמֵם־גּוֹי וְחֶסֶד לְאֻמִּים חַטָּאת׃
verses.english: Righteousness exalts a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

verses.hebrew: רְצוֹן־מֶלֶךְ לְעֶבֶד מַשְׂכִּיל וְעֶבְרָתוֹ תִּהְיֶה מֵבִישׁ׃
verses.english: The king’s favour is turned towards a wise servant: but his anger falls on one who acts shamefully.

verses.hebrew: מַעֲנֶה־רַּךְ יָשִׁיב חֵמָה וּדְבַר־עֶצֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָף׃
verses.english: A soft answer turns away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

verses.hebrew: לְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים תֵּיטִיב דָּעַת וּפִי כְסִילִים יַבִּיעַ אִוֶּלֶת׃
verses.english: The tongue of the wise uses knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools pours out foolishness.

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־מָקוֹם עֵינֵי יְהוָה צֹפוֹת רָעִים וטוֹבִים׃
verses.english: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, watching the evil and the good.

verses.hebrew: מַרְפֵּא לָשׁוֹן עֵץ חַיִּים וְסֶלֶף בָּהּ שֶׁבֶר בְּרוּחַ׃
verses.english: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a wound to the spirit.

verses.hebrew: אֱוִיל יִנְאַץ מוּסַר אָבִיו וְשֹׁמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יַעְרִם׃
verses.english: A fool despises his father’s correction: but he that regards reproof is prudent.

verses.hebrew: בֵּית צַדִּיק חֹסֶן רָב וּבִתְבוּאַת רָשָׁע נֶעְכָּרֶת׃
verses.english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים יְזָרוּ דָעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים לֹא־כֵן׃
verses.english: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish is vanity.

verses.hebrew: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וּתְפִלַּת יְשָׁרִים רְצוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ רָשָׁע וּמְרַדֵּף צְדָקָה יֶאֱהָב׃
verses.english: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he who follows after righteousness He will love.

verses.hebrew: מוּסָר רָע לְעֹזֵב אֹרַח שׂוֹנֵא תוֹכַחַת יָמוּת׃
verses.english: There is a severe correction for him who forsakes the way: he who hates re- proof shall die.

verses.hebrew: שְׁאוֹל וַאֲבַדּוֹן נֶגֶד יְהוָה אַף כִּי־לִבּוֹת בְּנֵי־אָדָם׃
verses.english: She᾽ol and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

verses.hebrew: לֹא יֶאֱהַב־לֵץ הוֹכֵחַ לוֹ אֶל־חֲכָמִים לֹא יֵלֵךְ׃
verses.english: A scorner does not like to be reproved; nor will he go to the wise.

verses.hebrew: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב פָּנִים וּבְעַצְּבַת־לֵב רוּחַ נְכֵאָה׃
verses.english: A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

verses.hebrew: לֵב נָבוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־דָּעַת ופני [וּפִי] כְסִילִים יִרְעֶה אִוֶּלֶת׃
verses.english: The heart of the judicious seeks knowledge: but the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי עָנִי רָעִים וְטוֹב־לֵב מִשְׁתֶּה תָמִיד׃
verses.english: All the days of the poor are evil: but he that is of a merry heart has a continual feast.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־מְעַט בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מֵאוֹצָר רָב וּמְהוּמָה בוֹ׃
verses.english: Better is little with the fear of the Lord, than great treasure and trouble with it.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב אֲרֻחַת יָרָק וְאַהֲבָה־שָׁם מִשּׁוֹר אָבוּס וְשִׂנְאָה־בוֹ׃
verses.english: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a fatted ox and hatred with it.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ חֵמָה יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וְאֶרֶך אַפַּיִם יַשְׁקִיט רִיב׃
verses.english: A wrathful man stirs up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeases strife.

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ עָצֵל כִּמְשֻׂכַת חָדֶק וְאֹרַח יְשָׁרִים סְלֻלָה׃
verses.english: The way of a sluggard is as hedged in with thorns: but the path of the righteous is level.

verses.hebrew: בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָב וּכְסִיל אָדָם בּוֹזֶה אִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: A Wise son makes a glad father: but a foolish man despises his mother.

verses.hebrew: אִוֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָה לַחֲסַר־לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יְיַשֶׁר־לָכֶת׃
verses.english: Folly is joy to him who is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walks straight forward.

verses.hebrew: הָפֵר מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵין סוֹד וּבְרֹב יוֹעֲצִים תָּקוּם׃
verses.english: Without counsel purposes are frustrated: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחָה לָאִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־פִיו וְדָבָר בְּעִתּוֹ מַה־טּוֹב׃
verses.english: A man has joy in the answer of his mouth: and a word in due season, how good it is!

verses.hebrew: אֹרַח חַיִּים לְמַעְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּיל לְמַעַן סוּר מִשְּׁאוֹל מָטָּה׃
verses.english: The way of life for the wise leads upward, that he may depart from She᾽ol beneath.

verses.hebrew: בֵּית גֵּאִים יִסַּח יְהוָה וְיַצֵּב גְּבוּל אַלְמָנָה׃
verses.english: The Lord will pluck up the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה מַחְשְׁבוֹת רָע וּטְהֹרִים אִמְרֵי־נֹעַם׃
verses.english: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but pleasant words are pure.

verses.hebrew: עֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ בּוֹצֵעַ בָּצַע וְשׂוֹנֵא מַתָּנֹת יִחְיֶה׃
verses.english: He that is greedy of gain troubles his own house; but he that hates gifts shall live.

verses.hebrew: לֵב צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה לַעֲנוֹת וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יַבִּיעַ רָעוֹת׃
verses.english: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer: but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.

verses.hebrew: רָחוֹק יְהוָה מֵרְשָׁעִים וּתְפִלַּת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׁמָע׃
verses.english: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

verses.hebrew: מְאוֹר־עֵינַיִם יְשַׂמַּח־לֵב שְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה תְּדַשֶּׁן־עָצֶם׃
verses.english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart: and a good report makes the bones fat.

verses.hebrew: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת תּוֹכַחַת חַיִּים בְּקֶרֶב חֲכָמִים תָּלִין׃
verses.english: The ear that listens to the reproof of life abides among the wise.

verses.hebrew: פּוֹרֵעַ מוּסָר מוֹאֵס נַפְשׁוֹ וְשׁוֹמֵעַ תּוֹכַחַת קוֹנֶה לֵּב׃
verses.english: He that refuses correction despises his own soul: but he that listens to reproof gets understanding.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מוּסַר חָכְמָה וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָה׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord is instruction in wisdom; and humility goes before honour.

verses.hebrew: לְאָדָם מַעַרְכֵי־לֵב וּמֵיְהוָה מַעֲנֵה לָשׁוֹן׃
verses.english: The thoughts of the heart are man’s, but from the Lord comes the utterance of the tongue.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ זַךְ בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן רוּחוֹת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weighs the spirits.

verses.hebrew: גֹּל אֶל־יְהוָה מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְיִכֹּנוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Commit thy works to the Lord, and thy plans shall be established.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל פָּעַל יְהוָה לַמַּעֲנֵהוּ וְגַם־רָשָׁע לְיוֹם רָעָה׃
verses.english: The Lord has made every thing for his own purpose: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה כָּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵב יָד לְיָד לֹא יִנָּקֶה׃
verses.english: Everyone that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: those who join hands in an evil cause shall not go unpunished.

verses.hebrew: בְּחֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְכֻפַּר עָוֺן וּבְיִרְאַת יְהוָה סוּר מֵרָע׃
verses.english: By loyalty and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

verses.hebrew: בִּרְצוֹת יְהוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ גַּם־אוֹיְבָיו יַשְׁלִם אִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: When a man’s ways please the Lord, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־מְעַט בִּצְדָקָה מֵרֹב תְּבוּאוֹת בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

verses.hebrew: לֵב אָדָם יְחַשֵּׁב דַּרְכּוֹ וַיהוָה יָכִין צַעֲדוֹ׃
verses.english: A man’s heart devises his way: but the Lord directs his steps.

verses.hebrew: קֶסֶם עַל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט לֹא יִמְעַל־פִּיו׃
verses.english: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth does not transgress in judgment.

verses.hebrew: פֶּלֶס וּמֹאזְנֵי מִשְׁפָּט לַיהוָה מַעֲשֵׂהוּ כָּל־אַבְנֵי־כִיס׃
verses.english: A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: all the weights in the bag are his work.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת מְלָכִים עֲשׂוֹת רֶשַׁע כִּי בִצְדָקָה יִכּוֹן כִּסֵּא׃
verses.english: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for a throne is established by righteousness.

verses.hebrew: רְצוֹן מְלָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר יְשָׁרִים יֶאֱהָב׃
verses.english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him who speaks what is right.

verses.hebrew: חֲמַת־מֶלֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָוֶת וְאִישׁ חָכָם יְכַפְּרֶנָּה׃
verses.english: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.hebrew: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶלֶךְ חַיִּים וּרְצוֹנוֹ כְּעָב מַלְקוֹשׁ׃
