verses.english: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud bringing the spring rain.

verses.hebrew: קְנֹה־חָכְמָה מַה־טּוֹב מֵחָרוּץ וּקְנוֹת בִּינָה נִבְחָר מִכָּסֶף׃
verses.english: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding is preferable to silver!

verses.hebrew: מְסִלַּת יְשָׁרִים סוּר מֵרָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ נֹצֵר דַּרְכּוֹ׃
verses.english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that guards his path preserves his soul.

verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁבֶר גָּאוֹן וְלִפְנֵי כִשָּׁלוֹן גֹּבַהּ רוּחַ׃
verses.english: Pride goes before destruction, and haughtiness of spirit before a fall.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב שְׁפַל־רוּחַ אֶת־עניים [עֲנָוִים] מֵחַלֵּק שָׁלָל אֶת־גֵּאִים׃
verses.english: Better it is to be of a humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל עַל־דָּבָר יִמְצָא־טוֹב וּבוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה אַשְׁרָיו׃
verses.english: He who considers his words shall find good: and he who trusts in the Lord shall be happy.

verses.hebrew: לַחֲכַם־לֵב יִקָּרֵא נָבוֹן וּמֶתֶק שְׂפָתַיִם יֹסִיף לֶקַח׃
verses.english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increases learning.

verses.hebrew: מְקוֹר חַיִּים שֵׂכֶל בְּעָלָיו וּמוּסַר אֱוִלִים אִוֶּלֶת׃
verses.english: Intelligence is a wellspring of life to him who has it: but folly is a chastisement to fools.

verses.hebrew: לֵב חָכָם יַשְׂכִּיל פִּיהוּ וְעַל־שְׂפָתָיו יֹסִיף לֶקַח׃
verses.english: The heart of the wise teaches his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

verses.hebrew: צוּף־דְּבַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹעַם מָתוֹק לַנֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּא לָעָצֶם׃
verses.english: Pleasant words are like a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי־מָוֶת׃
verses.english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but its end are the ways of death.

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ עָמֵל עָמְלָה לּוֹ כִּי־אָכַף עָלָיו פִּיהוּ׃
verses.english: The hunger of the labourer labours for him; for his mouth presses upon him.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל כֹּרֶה רָעָה וְעַל־שפתיו [שְׂפָתוֹ] כְּאֵשׁ צָרָבֶת׃
verses.english: An ungodly man digs up evil: and in his lips there is a kind of burning fire.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ תַּהְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּח מָדוֹן וְנִרְגָּן מַפְרִיד אַלּוּף׃
verses.english: A perverse man sows strife: and a whisperer separates close friends.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ חָמָס יְפַתֶּה רֵעֵהוּ וְהוֹלִיכוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ לֹא־טוֹב׃
verses.english: A violent man entices his neighbour, and leads him into a way that is not good:

verses.hebrew: עֹצֶה עֵינָיו לַחְשֹׁב תַּהְפֻּכוֹת קֹרֵץ שְׂפָתָיו כִּלָּה רָעָה׃
verses.english: he winks his eyes to devise crooked things: pursing his lips he brings evil to pass.

verses.hebrew: עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת שֵׂיבָה בְּדֶרֶךְ צְדָקָה תִּמָּצֵא׃
verses.english: The hoary head is a crown of glory; it is found in the way of righteousness.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם מִגִּבּוֹר וּמֹשֵׁל בְּרוּחוֹ מִלֹּכֵד עִיר׃
verses.english: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that rules his spirit than one who captures a city.

verses.hebrew: בַּחֵיק יוּטַל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָל וּמֵיְהוָה כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטוֹ׃
verses.english: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole of its decision is from the Lord.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב פַּת חֲרֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־בָהּ מִבַּיִת מָלֵא זִבְחֵי־רִיב׃
verses.english: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness with it, than a house full of feasting with strife.

verses.hebrew: עֶבֶד־מַשְׂכִּיל יִמְשֹׁל בְּבֵן מֵבִישׁ וּבְתוֹךְ אַחִים יַחֲלֹק נַחֲלָה׃
verses.english: A wise servant shall control a son who acts shamefully, and shall share the inheritance among the brethren.

verses.hebrew: מַצְרֵף לַכֶּסֶף וְכוּר לַזָּהָב וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord tries the hearts.

verses.hebrew: מֵרַע מַקְשִׁיב עַל־שְׂפַת־אָוֶן שֶׁקֶר מֵזִין עַל־לְשׁוֹן הַוֺּת׃
verses.english: A wicked doer gives heed to false lips; and a liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

verses.hebrew: לֹעֵג לָרָשׁ חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ שָׂמֵחַ לְאֵיד לֹא יִנָּקֶה׃
verses.english: One who mocks the poor insults his maker: and one who is glad at calamity shall not go unpunished.

verses.hebrew: עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָאוָה לְנָבָל שְׂפַת־יֶתֶר אַף כִּי־לְנָדִיב שְׂפַת־שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: Haughty speech does not befit a churl: much less do lying lips a prince.

verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן־חֵן הַשֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵי בְעָלָיו אֶל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יִפְנֶה יַשְׂכִּיל׃
verses.english: A bribe is a fair jewel to the eyes of him who dispenses it: wherever it turns it brings success.

verses.hebrew: מְכַסֶּה־פֶּשַׁע מְבַקֵּשׁ אַהֲבָה וְשֹׁנֶה בְדָבָר מַפְרִיד אַלּוּף׃
verses.english: He that covers a transgression seeks love; but he that repeats a matter separates close friends.

verses.hebrew: תֵּחַת גְּעָרָה בְמֵבִין מֵהַכּוֹת כְּסִיל מֵאָה׃
verses.english: A reproof enters more into a wise man than a hundred blows into a fool.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־מְרִי יְבַקֶּשׁ־רָע וּמַלְאָךְ אַכְזָרִי יְשֻׁלַּח־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: An evil man seeks only to be insolent: but a stern messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.hebrew: פָּגוֹשׁ דֹּב שַׁכּוּל בְּאִישׁ וְאַל־כְּסִיל בְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.hebrew: מֵשִׁיב רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה לֹא־תמיש [תָמוּשׁ] רָעָה מִבֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.hebrew: פּוֹטֵר מַיִם רֵאשִׁית מָדוֹן וְלִפְנֵי הִתְגַּלַּע הָרִיב נְטוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: The beginning of strife is like letting out water: therefore leave off contention, before it breaks out.

verses.hebrew: מַצְדִּיק רָשָׁע וּמַרְשִׁיעַ צַדִּיק תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the just, both of them are abomination to the Lord.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד־כְּסִיל לִקְנוֹת חָכְמָה וְלֶב־אָיִן׃
verses.english: Why is the purchase price of wisdom in the hand of a fool, seeing he has no sense?

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־עֵת אֹהֵב הָרֵעַ וְאָח לְצָרָה יִוָּלֵד׃
verses.english: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.hebrew: אָדָם חֲסַר־לֵב תּוֹקֵעַ כָּף עֹרֵב עֲרֻבָּה לִפְנֵי רֵעֵהוּ׃
verses.english: A man who strikes the palm is void of understanding, in becoming surety in the presence of his friend.

verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב פֶּשַׁע אֹהֵב מַצָּה מַגְבִּיהַּ פִּתְחוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־שָׁבֶר׃
verses.english: He loves transgression that loves strife: and he that makes high his door seeks destruction.

verses.hebrew: עִקֶּשׁ־לֵב לֹא יִמְצָא־טוֹב וְנֶהְפָּךְ בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ יִפּוֹל בְּרָעָה׃
verses.english: He that has a crooked heart finds no good: and he that has a perverse tongue falls into mischief.

verses.hebrew: יֹלֵד כְּסִיל לְתוּגָה לוֹ וְלֹא־יִשְׂמַח אֲבִי נָבָל׃
verses.english: He that begets a fool does it to his sorrow: and the father of a churl has no joy.

verses.hebrew: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב גֵּהָה וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־גָּרֶם׃
verses.english: A merry heart is a good medicine: but a broken spirit dries the bones.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁחַד מֵחֵיק רָשָׁע יִקָּח לְהַטּוֹת אָרְחוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: A wicked man takes a bribe out of the bosom to pervert the ways of justice.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־פְּנֵי מֵבִין חָכְמָה וְעֵינֵי כְסִיל בִּקְצֵה־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Wisdom is before him that has understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

verses.hebrew: כַּעַס לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וּמֶמֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bore him.

verses.hebrew: גַּם עֲנוֹשׁ לַצַּדִּיק לֹא־טוֹב לְהַכּוֹת נְדִיבִים עַל־יֹשֶׁר׃
verses.english: Neither is it good to punish an innocent man, nor to give blows to noble men for their integrity.

verses.hebrew: חוֹשֵׂךְ אֲמָרָיו יוֹדֵעַ דָּעַת וקר־[יְקַר־] רוּחַ אִישׁ תְּבוּנָה׃
verses.english: He that has knowledge spares his words: and a man of understanding is slow to anger.

verses.hebrew: גַּם אֱוִיל מַחֲרִישׁ חָכָם יֵחָשֵׁב אֹטֵם שְׂפָתָיו נָבוֹן׃
verses.english: Even a fool, when he holds his peace, is counted wise: and he that shuts his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

verses.hebrew: לְתַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּשׁ נִפְרָד בְּכָל־תּוּשִׁיָּה יִתְגַּלָּע׃
verses.english: He who keeps himself apart seeks to satisfy his own vanity: he breaks out against all sound policy.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַחְפֹּץ כְּסִיל בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי אִם־בְּהִתְגַּלּוֹת לִבּוֹ׃
verses.english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but that his heart may lay itself bare.

verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא־רָשָׁע בָּא גַם־בּוּז וְעִם־קָלוֹן חֶרְפָּה׃
verses.english: When the wicked comes, then comes also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

verses.hebrew: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים דִּבְרֵי פִי־אִישׁ נַחַל נֹבֵעַ מְקוֹר חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters, a flowing wadi, a fountain of wisdom.

verses.hebrew: שְׂאֵת פְּנֵי־רָשָׁע לֹא־טוֹב לְהַטּוֹת צַדִּיק בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: It is not good to favour the person of the wicked, so as to turn aside justice from the righteous.

verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי כְסִיל יָבֹאוּ בְרִיב וּפִיו לְמַהֲלֻמוֹת יִקְרָא׃
verses.english: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calls for strokes.

verses.hebrew: פִּי־כְסִיל מְחִתָּה־לוֹ וּשְׂפָתָיו מוֹקֵשׁ נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי נִרְגָּן כְּמִתְלַהֲמִים וְהֵם יָרְדוּ חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃
verses.english: The words of a talebearer are like dainties, and they go down into the innermost parts of the body.

verses.hebrew: גַּם מִתְרַפֶּה בִמְלַאכְתּוֹ אָח הוּא לְבַעַל מַשְׁחִית׃
verses.english: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him who destroys.

verses.hebrew: מִגְדַּל־עֹז שֵׁם יְהוָה בּוֹ־יָרוּץ צַדִּיק וְנִשְׂגָּב׃
verses.english: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runs into it, and is safe.

verses.hebrew: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ וּכְחוֹמָה נִשְׂגָּבָה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as a high wall in his own conceit.

verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁבֶר יִגְבַּהּ לֵב־אִישׁ וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָה׃
verses.english: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, but before honour goes humility.

verses.hebrew: מֵשִׁיב דָּבָר בְּטֶרֶם יִשְׁמָע אִוֶּלֶת הִיא־לוֹ וּכְלִמָּה׃
verses.english: He that answers a matter before he hears it, it is folly and shame to him.

verses.hebrew: רוּחַ־אִישׁ יְכַלְכֵּל מַחֲלֵהוּ וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה מִי יִשָּׂאֶנָּה׃
verses.english: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

verses.hebrew: לֵב נָבוֹן יִקְנֶה־דָּעַת וְאֹזֶן חֲכָמִים תְּבַקֶּשׁ־דָּעַת׃
verses.english: The heart of the prudent acquires knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

verses.hebrew: מַתָּן אָדָם יַרְחִיב לוֹ וְלִפְנֵי גְדֹלִים יַנְחֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּרִיבוֹ יבא־[וּבָא־] רֵעֵהוּ וַחֲקָרוֹ׃
verses.english: The one who pleads first seems to be in the right: then his neighbour comes forward, and sifts his case.

verses.hebrew: מִדְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּית הַגּוֹרָל וּבֵין עֲצוּמִים יַפְרִיד׃
verses.english: The lot causes contentions to cease, and it decides between the mighty.

verses.hebrew: אָח נִפְשָׁע מִקִּרְיַת־עֹז ומדונים [וּמִדְיָנִים] כִּבְרִיחַ אַרְמוֹן׃
verses.english: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

verses.hebrew: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ תִּשְׂבַּע בִּטְנוֹ תְּבוּאַת שְׂפָתָיו יִשְׂבָּע׃
verses.english: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

verses.hebrew: מָוֶת וְחַיִּים בְּיַד־לָשׁוֹן וְאֹהֲבֶיהָ יֹאכַל פִּרְיָהּ׃
verses.english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat its fruit.

verses.hebrew: מָצָא אִשָּׁה מָצָא טוֹב וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה׃
verses.english: He who finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favour of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: תַּחֲנוּנִים יְדַבֶּר־רָשׁ וְעָשִׁיר יַעֲנֶה עַזּוֹת׃
verses.english: The poor uses entreaties; but the rich answers with impudence.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ רֵעִים לְהִתְרֹעֵעַ וְיֵשׁ אֹהֵב דָּבֵק מֵאָח׃
verses.english: There are friends who merely pretend friendship: and there is a true friend who is closer than a brother.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־רָשׁ הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ מֵעִקֵּשׁ שְׂפָתָיו וְהוּא כְסִיל׃
verses.english: Better is the poor man who walks in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

verses.hebrew: גַּם בְּלֹא־דַעַת נֶפֶשׁ לֹא־טוֹב וְאָץ בְּרַגְלַיִם חוֹטֵא׃
verses.english: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; and he that hastens with his feet sins.

verses.hebrew: אִוֶּלֶת אָדָם תְּסַלֵּף דַּרְכּוֹ וְעַל־יְהוָה יִזְעַף לִבּוֹ׃
verses.english: The foolishness of a man perverts his way: and his heart frets against the Lord.

verses.hebrew: הוֹן יֹסִיף רֵעִים רַבִּים וְדָל מֵרֵעהוּ יִפָּרֵד׃
verses.english: Wealth makes many friends; but as for the poor, his neighbour keeps himself apart.

verses.hebrew: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים לֹא יִמָּלֵט׃
verses.english: A false witness shall not go unpunished, and he that utters lies shall not escape.

verses.hebrew: רַבִּים יְחַלּוּ פְנֵי־נָדִיב וְכָל־הָרֵעַ לְאִישׁ מַתָּן׃
verses.english: Many will entreat the favour of the generous man: and every man is a friend to him that gives gifts.

verses.hebrew: כָּל אֲחֵי־רָשׁ שְׂנֵאֻהוּ אַף כִּי מְרֵעֵהוּ רָחֲקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְרַדֵּף אֲמָרִים לא־[לוֹ־] הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? Their word for him is, Pursuer.

verses.hebrew: קֹנֶה־לֵּב אֹהֵב נַפְשׁוֹ שֹׁמֵר תְּבוּנָה לִמְצֹא־טוֹב׃
verses.english: He that gets wisdom loves his own soul: he that keeps understanding shall find good.

verses.hebrew: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים יֹאבֵד׃
verses.english: A false witness shall not go unpunished, and he that utters lies shall perish.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל תַּעֲנוּג אַף כִּי־לְעֶבֶד מְשֹׁל בְּשָׂרִים׃
verses.english: Luxury is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.hebrew: שֵׂכֶל אָדָם הֶאֱרִיךְ אַפּוֹ וְתִפאַרְתּוֹ עֲבֹר עַל־פָּשַׁע׃
verses.english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.hebrew: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר זַעַף מֶלֶךְ וּכְטַל עַל־עֵשֶׂב רְצוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion; and his favour is like dew upon the grass.

verses.hebrew: הַוֺּת לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וְדֶלֶף טֹרֵד מִדְיְנֵי אִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual drip.

verses.hebrew: בַּיִת וָהוֹן נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת וּמֵיְהוָה אִשָּׁה מַשְׂכָּלֶת׃
verses.english: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: but a prudent wife is from the Lord.

verses.hebrew: עַצְלָה תַּפִּיל תַּרְדֵּמָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְמִיָּה תִרְעָב׃
verses.english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep; and the idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר מִצְוָה שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ בּוֹזֵה דְרָכָיו יומת [יָמוּת׃]
verses.english: He that keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; but he that despises his ways shall die.

verses.hebrew: מַלְוֵה יְהוָה חוֹנֵן דָּל וּגְמֻלוֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ׃
verses.english: He that gives graciously to the poor makes a loan to the Lord; and that which he has given he will pay him back.

verses.hebrew: יַסֵּר בִּנְךָ כִּי־יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה וְאֶל־הֲמִיתוֹ אַל־תִּשָּׂא נַפְשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: Chastise thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

verses.hebrew: גרל־[גְּדָל־] חֵמָה נֹשֵׂא עֹנֶשׁ כִּי אִם־תַּצִּיל וְעוֹד תּוֹסִף׃
verses.english: A man of great anger shall suffer the penalty; for if thou interpose, that shall only add to it.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע עֵצָה וְקַבֵּל מוּסָר לְמַעַן תֶּחְכַּם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayst be wise in thy latter end.

verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּלֶב־אִישׁ וַעֲצַת יְהוָה הִיא תָקוּם׃
verses.english: There are many devices in a man’s heart; but the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת אָדָם חַסְדּוֹ וְטוֹב־רָשׁ מֵאִישׁ כָּזָב׃
verses.english: The attraction of a man is his kindness: but a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה לְחַיִּים וְשָׂבֵעַ יָלִין בַּל־יִפָּקֶד רָע׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord tends to life: and he that has it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

verses.hebrew: טָמַן עָצֵל יָדוֹ בַּצַּלָּחַת גַּם־אֶל־פִּיהוּ לֹא יְשִׁיבֶנָּה׃
verses.english: A lazy man hides his hand in the dish, and will not so much as bring it back to his mouth.

verses.hebrew: לֵץ תַּכֶּה וּפֶתִי יַעְרִם וְהוֹכִיחַ לְנָבוֹן יָבִין דָּעַת׃
verses.english: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: but rebuke one that has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

verses.hebrew: מְשַׁדֶּד־אָב יַבְרִיחַ אֵם בֵּן מֵבִישׁ וּמַחְפִּיר׃
verses.english: A son of scandalous and shameful ways shall ruin his father, and drive his mother away.

verses.hebrew: חַדַל־בְּנִי לִשְׁמֹעַ מוּסָר לִשְׁגוֹת מֵאִמְרֵי־דָעַת׃
verses.english: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction only to stray from the words of knowledge.

verses.hebrew: עֵד בְּלִיַּעַל יָלִיץ מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְבַלַּע־אָוֶן׃
verses.english: An ungodly witness scorns justice: and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.

verses.hebrew: נָכוֹנוּ לַלֵּצִים שְׁפָטִים וּמַהֲלֻמוֹת לְגֵו כְּסִילִים׃
verses.english: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

verses.hebrew: לֵץ הַיַּין הֹמֶה שֵׁכָר וְכָל־שֹׁגֶה בּוֹ לֹא יֶחְכָּם׃
verses.english: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is riotous, and whoever is misled thereby is not wise.

verses.hebrew: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר אֵימַת מֶלֶךְ מִתְעַבְּרוֹ חוֹטֵא נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: he who provokes him to anger forfeits his life.

verses.hebrew: כָּבוֹד לָאִישׁ שֶׁבֶת מֵרִיב וְכָל־אֱוִיל יִתְגַּלָּע׃
verses.english: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will burst out.

verses.hebrew: מֵחֹרֶף עָצֵל לֹא־יַחֲרֹשׁ ישאל [וְשָׁאַל] בַּקָּצִיר וָאָיִן׃
verses.english: The sluggard will not plough by reason of the cold; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

verses.hebrew: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים עֵצָה בְלֶב־אִישׁ וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יִדְלֶנָּה׃
verses.english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

verses.hebrew: רָב־אָדָם יִקְרָא אִישׁ חַסְדּוֹ וְאִישׁ אֱמוּנִים מִי יִמְצָא׃
verses.english: Most men will proclaim everyone his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

verses.hebrew: מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ צַדִּיק אַשְׁרֵי בָנָיו אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: The just man walks in his integrity: happy are his children after him.

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא־דִין מְזָרֶה בְעֵינָיו כָּל־רָע׃
verses.english: A king that sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יֹאמַר זִכִּיתִי לִבִּי טָהַרְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִי׃
verses.english: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן וָאֶבֶן אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike an abomination to the Lord.

verses.hebrew: גַּם בְּמַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־נָעַר אִם־זַךְ וְאִם־יָשָׁר פָּעֳלוֹ׃
verses.english: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

verses.hebrew: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת וְעַיִן רֹאָה יְהוָה עָשָׂה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye: the Lord has made them both.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֶּאֱהַב שֵׁנָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵשׁ פְּקַח עֵינֶיךָ שְׂבַע־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Do not love sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thy eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

verses.hebrew: רַע רַע יֹאמַר הַקּוֹנֶה וְאֹזֵל לוֹ אָז יִתְהַלָּל׃
verses.english: It is bad, it is bad, says the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ זָהָב וְרָב־פְּנִינִים וּכְלִי יְקָר שִׂפְתֵי־דָעַת׃
verses.english: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

verses.hebrew: לְקַח־בִּגְדוֹ כִּי־עָרַב זָר וּבְעַד נכרים [נָכְרִיָּה] חַבְלֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Take his garment when he has become surety for a stranger: and take his pledge on behalf of an alien woman.

verses.hebrew: עָרֵב לָאִישׁ לֶחֶם שָׁקֶר וְאַחַר יִמָּלֵא־פִיהוּ חָצָץ׃
verses.english: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

verses.hebrew: מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָה תִכּוֹן וּבְתַחְבֻּלוֹת עֲשֵׂה מִלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice conduct war.

verses.hebrew: גּוֹלֶה־סּוֹד הוֹלֵךְ רָכִיל וּלְפֹתֶה שְׂפָתָיו לֹא תִתְעָרָב׃
verses.english: He that goes about as a talebearer reveals secrets: therefore meddle not with him who prates with his lips.

verses.hebrew: מְקַלֵּל אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ יִדְעַךְ נֵרוֹ באישון [בֶּאֱשׁוּן] חֹשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: He who curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in utter darkness.

verses.hebrew: נַחֲלָה מבחלת [מְבֹהֶלֶת] בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ לֹא תְבֹרָךְ׃
verses.english: An estate may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but its end shall not be blessed.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֹּאמַר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־רָע קַוֵּה לַיהוָה וְיֹשַׁע לָךְ׃
verses.english: Do not say, I will repay evil; but wait on the Lord, and he will save thee.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן וּמֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה לֹא־טוֹב׃
verses.english: Divers weights are an abomination to the Lord; and a false balance is not good.

verses.hebrew: מֵיהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי־גָבֶר וְאָדָם מַה־יָּבִין דַּרְכּוֹ׃
verses.english: Man’s goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?

verses.hebrew: מוֹקֵשׁ אָדָם יָלַע קֹדֶשׁ וְאַחַר נְדָרִים לְבַקֵּר׃
verses.english: It is a snare to a man rashly to declare, It is holy; and afterwards to probe his vows.

verses.hebrew: מְזָרֶה רְשָׁעִים מֶלֶךְ חָכָם וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אוֹפָן׃
verses.english: A wise king scatters the wicked, and drives the wheel over them.

verses.hebrew: נֵר יְהוָה נִשְׁמַת אָדָם חֹפֵשׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃
verses.english: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

verses.hebrew: חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־מֶלֶךְ וְסָעַד בַּחֶסֶד כִּסְאוֹ׃
verses.english: Love and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upheld by loyalty.

verses.hebrew: תִּפְאֶרֶת בַּחוּרִים כֹּחָם וַהֲדַר זְקֵנִים שֵׂיבָה׃
verses.english: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.

verses.hebrew: חַבֻּרוֹת פֶּצַע תמריק [תַּמְרוּק] בְּרָע וּמַכּוֹת חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃
verses.english: Bruises and wounds purge away evil: so do stripes which reach the inward parts.

verses.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם לֶב־מֶלֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהוָה עַל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יַחְפֹּץ יַטֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: Like water courses is the king’s heart in the hand of the Lord: he directs it wherever he wishes.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִישׁ יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord weighs the heart.

verses.hebrew: עֲשֹׂה צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט נִבְחָר לַיהוָה מִזָּבַח׃
verses.english: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: רוּם־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵב נִר רְשָׁעִים חַטָּאת׃
verses.english: A haughty look, and a proud heart are the sinful growth of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: מַחְשְׁבוֹת חָרוּץ אַךְ־לְמוֹתָר וְכָל־אָץ אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר׃
verses.english: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but everyone that is hasty comes to want.

verses.hebrew: פֹּעַל אוֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר הֶבֶל נִדָּף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָוֶת׃
verses.english: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapour: they lead to death.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִים יְגוֹרֵם כִּי מֵאֲנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do justice.

verses.hebrew: הֲפַכְפַּךְ דֶּרֶךְ אִישׁ וָזָר וְזַךְ יָשָׁר פָּעֳלוֹ׃
verses.english: The way of some men is crooked and strange; but as for the pure, his work is right.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב לָשֶׁבֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּג מֵאֵשֶׁת מִדְיָנִים וּבֵית חָבֶר׃
verses.english: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a roomy house.

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ רָשָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָע לֹא־יֻחַן בְּעֵינָיו רֵעֵהוּ׃
verses.english: The soul of the wicked desires evil: his neighbour finds no favour in his eyes.

verses.hebrew: בַּעְנָשׁ־לֵץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּתִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּיל לְחָכָם יִקַּח־דָּעַת׃
verses.english: When the scorner is punished, the simple man is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל צַדִּיק לְבֵית רָשָׁע מְסַלֵּף רְשָׁעִים לָרָע׃
verses.english: The righteous man who considers the house of the wicked, leads the wicked astray to greater evil.

verses.hebrew: אֹטֵם אָזְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּל גַּם־הוּא יִקְרָא וְלֹא יֵעָנֶה׃
verses.english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

verses.hebrew: מַתָּן בַּסֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָף וְשֹׁחַד בַּחֵק חֵמָה עַזָּה׃
verses.english: A gift in secret pacifies anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחָה לַצַּדִּיק עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but it is the downfall of the workers of iniquity.

verses.hebrew: אָדָם תּוֹעֶה מִדֶּרֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּל בִּקְהַל רְפָאִים יָנוּחַ׃
verses.english: The man that wanders out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the shades.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ מַחְסוֹר אֹהֵב שִׂמְחָה אֹהֵב יַיִן־וָשֶׁמֶן לֹא יַעֲשִׁיר׃
verses.english: He that loves pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loves wine and oil shall not be rich.

verses.hebrew: כֹּפֶר לַצַּדִּיק רָשָׁע וְתַחַת יְשָׁרִים בּוֹגֵד׃
verses.english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב שֶׁבֶת בְּאֶרֶץ־מִדְבָּר מֵאֵשֶׁת מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] וָכָעַס׃
verses.english: It is better to live in the wilderness, than with a contentious and shrewish woman.

verses.hebrew: אוֹצָר נֶחְמָד וָשֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵה חָכָם וּכְסִיל אָדָם יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: Costly things and oil are treasured up in the wise man’s dwelling: but a fool devours them.

verses.hebrew: רֹדֵף צְדָקָה וָחָסֶד יִמְצָא חַיִּים צְדָקָה וְכָבוֹד׃
verses.english: He that follows righteousness and loyalty finds life, righteousness, and honour.

verses.hebrew: עִיר גִּבֹּרִים עָלָה חָכָם וַיֹּרֶד עֹז מִבְטֶחָה׃
verses.english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and casts down the stronghold in which it trusts.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר פִּיו וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ שֹׁמֵר מִצָּרוֹת נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: He who guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

verses.hebrew: זֵד יָהִיר לֵץ שְׁמוֹ עוֹשֶׂה בְּעֶבְרַת זָדוֹן׃
verses.english: The proud and haughty one, scorner is his name, acts in arrogant wrath.

verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת עָצֵל תְּמִיתֶנּוּ כִּי־מֵאֲנוּ יָדָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת׃
verses.english: The desire of the lazy man kills him; for his hands refuse to labour;

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִתְאַוָּה תַאֲוָה וְצַדִּיק יִתֵּן וְלֹא יַחְשֹׂךְ׃
verses.english: he covets greedily all the day long: but the righteous gives and spares not.

verses.hebrew: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָה אַף כִּי־בְזִמָּה יְבִיאֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: how much more, when he brings it with evil intent?

verses.hebrew: עֵד־כְּזָבִים יֹאבֵד וְאִישׁ שׁוֹמֵעַ לָנֶצַח יְדַבֵּר׃
verses.english: A false witness shall perish: but the word of a man who truly attends shall endure.

verses.hebrew: הֵעֵז אִישׁ רָשָׁע בְּפָנָיו וְיָשָׁר הוּא יכין [יָבִין] דרכיו [דַּרְכּוֹ׃]
verses.english: A wicked man hardens his face: but as for the upright, he considers his way.

verses.hebrew: אֵין חָכְמָה וְאֵין תְּבוּנָה וְאֵין עֵצָה לְנֶגֶד יְהוָה׃
verses.english: There is no wisdom or understanding or counsel against the Lord.

verses.hebrew: סוּס מוּכָן לְיוֹם מִלְחָמָה וְלַיהוָה הַתְּשׁוּעָה׃
verses.english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle: but safety comes from the Lord.

verses.hebrew: נִבְחָר שֵׁם מֵעֹשֶׁר רָב מִכֶּסֶף וּמִזָּהָב חֵן טוֹב׃
verses.english: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and amiable grace rather than silver or gold.

verses.hebrew: עָשִׁיר וָרָשׁ נִפְגָּשׁוּ עֹשֵׂה כֻלָּם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.

verses.hebrew: עָרוּם רָאָה רָעָה ויסתר [וְנִסְתָּר] וּפְתָיִים עָבְרוּ וְנֶעֱנָשׁוּ׃
verses.english: A prudent man foresees evil, and hides himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

verses.hebrew: עֵקֶב עֲנָוָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד וְחַיִּים׃
verses.english: The reward of humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.

verses.hebrew: צִנִּים פַּחִים בְּדֶרֶךְ עִקֵּשׁ שׁוֹמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ יִרְחַק מֵהֶם׃
verses.english: Thorns and snares are in the way of the crooked man: he that guards his soul shall be far from them.

verses.hebrew: חֲנֹךְ לַנַּעַר עַל־פִּי דַרְכּוֹ גַּם כִּי־יַזְקִין לֹא־יָסוּר מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

verses.hebrew: עָשִׁיר בְּרָשִׁים יִמְשׁוֹל וְעֶבֶד לֹוֶה לְאִישׁ מַלְוֶה׃
verses.english: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.hebrew: זוֹרֵעַ עַוְלָה יקצור־[יִקְצָר־] אָוֶן וְשֵׁבֶט עֶבְרָתוֹ יִכְלֶה׃
verses.english: He that sows iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his arrogance shall fail.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־עַיִן הוּא יְבֹרָךְ כִּי־נָתַן מִלַּחְמוֹ לַדָּל׃
verses.english: He that has a generous eye shall be blessed; for he gives of his bread to the poor.

verses.hebrew: גָּרֵשׁ לֵץ וְיֵצֵא מָדוֹן וְיִשְׁבֹּת דִּין וְקָלוֹן׃
verses.english: Cast out the scorner, and contention will go out; yea, strife and disgrace will cease.

verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב טהור־[טְהָר־] לֵב חֵן שְׂפָתָיו רֵעֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: He that loves pureness of heart, and grace is on his lips, the king shall be his friend.

verses.hebrew: עֵינֵי יְהוָה נָצְרוּ דָעַת וַיְסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי בֹגֵד׃
verses.english: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthrows the words of the transgressor.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר עָצֵל אֲרִי בַחוּץ בְּתוֹךְ רְחֹבוֹת אֵרָצֵחַ׃
verses.english: The lazy man says, There is a lion outside, I shall be slain in the streets.

verses.hebrew: שׁוּחָה עֲמֻקָּה פִּי זָרוֹת זְעוּם יְהוָה יפול־[יִפָּל־] שָׁם׃
verses.english: The mouth of strange woman is a deep pit: he who incurs the Lord’s indignation shall fall therein.

verses.hebrew: אִוֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָה בְלֶב־נָעַר שֵׁבֶט מוּסָר יַרְחִיקֶנָּה מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

verses.hebrew: עֹשֵׁק דָּל לְהַרְבּוֹת לוֹ נֹתֵן לְעָשִׁיר אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר׃
verses.english: He that oppresses the poor may well bring him gain, and he that gives to the rich, may nevertheless come to want.

verses.hebrew: הַט אָזְנְךָ וּשְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים וְלִבְּךָ תָּשִׁית לְדַעְתִּי׃
verses.english: Incline thy ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thy heart to my knowledge.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָעִים כִּי־תִשְׁמְרֵם בְּבִטְנֶךָ יִכֹּנוּ יַחְדָּו עַל־שְׂפָתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; let them be firmly attached together to thy lips.

verses.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְטַחֶךָ הוֹדַעְתִּיךָ הַיּוֹם אַף־אָתָּה׃
verses.english: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא כָתַבְתִּי לְךָ שלשום [שָׁלִישִׁים] בְּמוֹעֵצֹת וָדָעַת׃
verses.english: Have I not written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

verses.hebrew: לְהוֹדִיעֲךָ קֹשְׁטְ אִמְרֵי אֱמֶת לְהָשִׁיב אֲמָרִים אֱמֶת לְשֹׁלְחֶיךָ׃
verses.english: that I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to those who send thee?

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּגְזָל־דָּל כִּי דַל־הוּא וְאַל־תְּדַכֵּא עָנִי בַשָּׁעַר׃
verses.english: Do not rob the poor, because he is poor: nor oppress the afflicted in the gate:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה יָרִיב רִיבָם וְקָבַע אֶת־קֹבְעֵיהֶם נָפֶשׁ׃
verses.english: for the Lord will plead their cause, and rob life those who rob them.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְרַע אֶת־בַּעַל אָף וְאֶת־אִישׁ חֵמוֹת לֹא תָבוֹא׃
verses.english: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־תֶּאֱלַף ארחתו [אֹרְחֹתָיו] וְלָקַחְתָּ מוֹקֵשׁ לְנַפְשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי בְתֹקְעֵי־כָף בַּעֹרְבִים מַשָּׁאוֹת׃
verses.english: Be not thou one of those who strike the palm, or of those who are sureties for debts.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֵין־לְךָ לְשַׁלֵּם לָמָּה יִקַּח מִשְׁכָּבְךָ מִתַּחְתֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: If thou hast nothing with which to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסֵּג גְּבוּל עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

verses.hebrew: חָזִיתָ אִישׁ מָהִיר בִּמְלַאכְתּוֹ לִפְנֵי־מְלָכִים יִתְיַצָּב בַּל־יִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי חֲשֻׁכִּים׃
verses.english: Dost thou see a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before obscure men.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תֵשֵׁב לִלְחוֹם אֶת־מוֹשֵׁל בִּין תָּבִין אֶת־אֲשֶׁר לְפָנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler consider diligently what is before thee:

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ שַׂכִּין בְּלֹעֶךָ אִם־בַּעַל נֶפֶשׁ אָתָּה׃
verses.english: and put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְאָו לְמַטְעַמּוֹתָיו וְהוּא לֶחֶם כְּזָבִים׃
verses.english: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful food.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּיגַע לְהַעֲשִׁיר מִבִּינָתְךָ חֲדָל׃
verses.english: Do not toil to be rich: because thou hast understanding, forbear.

verses.hebrew: התעוף [הֲתָעִיף] עֵינֶיךָ בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ כִּי עָשֹׂה יַעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ כְנָפַיִם כְּנֶשֶׁר ועיף [יָעוּף] הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: Wilt thou set thy eyes upon it? it is already gone: for riches suddenly make themselves wings; they fly away like an eagle towards the sky.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּלְחַם אֶת־לֶחֶם רַע עָיִן וְאַל־תתאו [תִּתְאָיו] לְמַטְעַמֹּתָיו׃
verses.english: Do not eat the bread of him who has an evil eye, nor desire his dainties.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כְּמוֹ־שָׁעַר בְּנַפְשׁוֹ כֶּן־הוּא אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה יֹאמַר לָךְ וְלִבּוֹ בַּל־עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: For as one that calculates in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, says he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.

verses.hebrew: פִּתְּךָ־אָכַלְתָּ תְקִיאֶנָּה וְשִׁחַתָּ דְּבָרֶיךָ הַנְּעִימִים׃
verses.english: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

verses.hebrew: בְּאָזְנֵי כְסִיל אַל־תְּדַבֵּר כִּי־יָבוּז לְשֵׂכֶל מִלֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: Do not speak in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסֵּג גְּבוּל עוֹלָם וּבִשְׂדֵי יְתוֹמִים אַל־תָּבֹא׃
verses.english: Do not remove the old landmark; and do not enter the fields of the fatherless:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־גֹאֲלָם חָזָק הוּא־יָרִיב אֶת־רִיבָם אִתָּךְ׃
verses.english: for their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

verses.hebrew: הָבִיאָה לַמּוּסָר לִבֶּךָ וְאָזְנֶךָ לְאִמְרֵי־דָעַת׃
verses.english: Apply thy heart to instruction, and thy ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּמְנַע מִנַּעַר מוּסָר כִּי־תַכֶּנּוּ בַשֵּׁבֶט לֹא יָמוּת׃
verses.english: Do not withhold correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he will not die.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה בַּשֵּׁבֶט תַּכֶּנּוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּצִּיל׃
verses.english: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־חָכַם לִבֶּךָ יִשְׂמַח לִבִּי גַם־אָנִי׃
verses.english: My son, if thy heart is wise, my heart too shall rejoice:

verses.hebrew: וְתַעְלֹזְנָה כִלְיוֹתָי בְּדַבֵּר שְׂפָתֶיךָ מֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: and my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יְקַנֵּא לִבְּךָ בַּחַטָּאִים כִּי אִם־בְּיִרְאַת־יְהוָה כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: Let not thy heart envy sinners: but be in the fear of the Lord all the day long.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־יֵשׁ אַחֲרִית וְתִקְוָתְךָ לֹא תִכָּרֵת׃
verses.english: For surely there is a future; and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־אַתָּה בְנִי וַחֲכָם וְאַשֵּׁר בַּדֶּרֶךְ לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Hear, my son, and be wise, and guide thy heart in the way.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי בְסֹבְאֵי־יָיִן בְּזֹלֲלֵי בָשָׂר לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: Be not among winebibbers; among gluttonous eaters of meat:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־סֹבֵא וְזוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵשׁ וּקְרָעִים תַּלְבִּישׁ נוּמָה׃
verses.english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע לְאָבִיךָ זֶה יְלָדֶךָ וְאַל־תָּבוּז כִּי־זָקְנָה אִמֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Hearken to thy father who begot thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

verses.hebrew: אֱמֶת קְנֵה וְאַל־תִּמְכֹּר חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר וּבִינָה׃
verses.english: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

verses.hebrew: גול [גִּיל] יגול [יָגִיל] אֲבִי צַדִּיק יולד [וְיוֹלֵד] חָכָם וישמח־[יִשְׂמַח־] בּוֹ׃
verses.english: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he who begets a wise child shall have joy of him.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח־אָבִיךָ וְאִמֶּךָ וְתָגֵל יוֹלַדְתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Let thy father and thy mother be glad, and let her who bore thee rejoice.

verses.hebrew: תְּנָה־בְנִי לִבְּךָ לִי וְעֵינֶיךָ דְּרָכַי תרצנה [תִּצֹּרְנָה׃]
verses.english: My son, give me thy heart, and let thy eyes observe my ways.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שׁוּחָה עֲמֻקָּה זוֹנָה וּבְאֵר צָרָה נָכְרִיָּה׃
verses.english: For a harlot is a deep ditch; and an alien woman is a narrow pit.

verses.hebrew: אַף־הִיא כְּחֶתֶף תֶּאֱרֹב וּבוֹגְדִים בְּאָדָם תּוֹסִף׃
verses.english: She also lies in wait like a robber, and increases the transgressors among men.

verses.hebrew: לְמִי אוֹי לְמִי אֲבוֹי לְמִי מדונים [מִדְיָנִים ] לְמִי שִׂיחַ לְמִי פְּצָעִים חִנָּם לְמִי חַכְלִלוּת עֵינָיִם׃
verses.english: Who cries, Woe? who cries, Alas? who has quarrels? who has complaints? who has causeless injuries? who has redness of eyes?

verses.hebrew: לַמְאַחֲרִים עַל־הַיָּיִן לַבָּאִים לַחְקֹר מִמְסָךְ׃
verses.english: They who tarry long at the wine; they who go to seek mixed wine.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּרֶא יַיִן כִּי יִתְאַדָּם כִּי־יִתֵּן בכיס [בַּכּוֹס] עֵינוֹ יִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: Look not upon the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly:

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרִיתוֹ כְּנָחָשׁ יִשָּׁךְ וּכְצִפְעֹנִי יַפְרִשׁ׃
verses.english: at the last it bites like a snake, and stings like a viper.

verses.hebrew: עֵינֶיךָ יִרְאוּ זָרוֹת וְלִבְּךָ יְדַבֵּר תַּהְפֻּכוֹת׃
verses.english: Thy eyes shall behold strange things, and thy heart shall utter perverse words.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ כְּשֹׁכֵב בְּלֶב־יָם וּכְשֹׁכֵב בְּרֹאשׁ חִבֵּל׃
verses.english: Yea, thou shalt be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea, or like one who lies upon the top of a mast.

verses.hebrew: הִכּוּנִי בַל־חָלִיתִי הֲלָמוּנִי בַּל־יָדָעְתִּי מָתַי אָקִיץ אוֹסִיף אֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ עוֹד׃
verses.english: They have struck me, but I was not hurt; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁי רָעָה וְאַל־תתאו [תִּתְאָיו] לִהְיוֹת אִתָּם׃
verses.english: Be not envious of evil men, nor desire to be with them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שֹׁד יֶהְגֶּה לִבָּם וְעָמָל שִׂפְתֵיהֶם תְּדַבֵּרְנָה׃
verses.english: For their heart studies destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

verses.hebrew: בְּחָכְמָה יִבָּנֶה בָּיִת וּבִתְבוּנָה יִתְכּוֹנָן׃
verses.english: Through wisdom a house is built; and by understanding it is established:

verses.hebrew: וּבְדַעַת חֲדָרִים יִמָּלְאוּ כָּל־הוֹן יָקָר וְנָעִים׃
verses.english: and by knowledge are the chambers filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר־חָכָם בַּעוֹז וְאִישׁ־דַּעַת מְאַמֶּץ־כֹּחַ׃
verses.english: A wise man is strong; and a man of knowledge increases strength.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְתַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ מִלְחָמָה וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵץ׃
verses.english: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is victory.

verses.hebrew: רָאמוֹת לֶאֱוִיל חָכְמוֹת בַּשַּׁעַר לֹא יִפְתַּח־פִּיהוּ׃
verses.english: Wisdom it too high for a fool: he does not open his mouth in the gate.

verses.hebrew: מְחַשֵּׁב לְהָרֵעַ לוֹ בַּעַל־מְזִמּוֹת יִקְרָאוּ׃
verses.english: He who devises to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

verses.hebrew: זִמַּת אִוֶּלֶת חַטָּאת וְתוֹעֲבַת לְאָדָם לֵץ׃
verses.english: The devising of folly is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

verses.hebrew: הִתְרַפִּיתָ בְּיוֹם צָרָה צַר כֹּחֶכָה׃
verses.english: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small:

verses.hebrew: הַצֵּל לְקֻחִים לַמָּוֶת וּמָטִים לַהֶרֶג אִם־תַּחְשׂוֹךְ׃
verses.english: if thou forbear to rescue those who are drawn to death, and those who are ready to be slain;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תֹאמַר הֵן לֹא־יָדַעְנוּ זֶה הֲ‍לֹא־תֹכֵן לִבּוֹת הוּא־יָבִין וְנֹצֵר נַפְשְׁךָ הוּא יֵדָע וְהֵשִׁיב לְאָדָם כְּפָעֳלוֹ׃
verses.english: if thou sayst, Behold, we knew it not, does not he who ponders the heart consider it? and he who keeps thy soul, does he not know it? and shall he not render to every man according to his works?

verses.hebrew: אֱכָל־בְּנִי דְבַשׁ כִּי־טוֹב וְנֹפֶת מָתוֹק עַל־חִכֶּךָ׃
verses.english: My son, eat honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

verses.hebrew: כֵּן דְּעֶה חָכְמָה לְנַפְשֶׁךָ אִם־מָצָאתָ וְיֵשׁ אַחֲרִית וְתִקְוָתְךָ לֹא תִכָּרֵת׃
verses.english: know that such is wisdom for thy soul! when hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֶּאֱרֹב רָשָׁע לִנְוֵה צַדִּיק אַל־תְּשַׁדֵּד רִבְצוֹ׃
verses.english: Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; do not plunder his resting place:

verses.hebrew: כִּי שֶׁבַע יִפּוֹל צַדִּיק וָקָם וּרְשָׁעִים יִכָּשְׁלוּ בְרָעָה׃
verses.english: for a just man falls seven times, and yet rises up again: but the wicked stumble into mischief.

verses.hebrew: בִּנְפֹל אויביך [אוֹיִבְךָ] אַל־תִּשְׂמָח וּבִכָּשְׁלוֹ אַל־יָגֵל לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Do not rejoice when thy enemy falls, and do not let thy heart be glad when he stumbles:

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִרְאֶה יְהוָה וְרַע בְּעֵינָיו וְהֵשִׁיב מֵעָלָיו אַפּוֹ׃
verses.english: lest the Lord see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בָּרְשָׁעִים׃
verses.english: Fret not thyself because of evil men, nor be envious at the wicked;

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תִהְיֶה אַחֲרִית לָרָע נֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ׃
verses.english: for there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.hebrew: יְרָא־אֶת־יְהוָה בְּנִי וָמֶלֶךְ עִם־שׁוֹנִים אַל־תִּתְעָרָב׃
verses.english: My son, fear thou the Lord and the king: and do not meddle with them who are given to change:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־פִתְאֹם יָקוּם אֵידָם וּפִיד שְׁנֵיהֶם מִי יוֹדֵעַ׃
verses.english: for their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knows the ruin of them both?

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֵלֶּה לַחֲכָמִים הַכֵּר־פָּנִים בְּמִשְׁפָּט בַּל־טוֹב׃
verses.english: These words also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

verses.hebrew: אֹמֵר לְרָשָׁע צַדִּיק אָתָּה יִקְּבֻהוּ עַמִּים יִזְעָמוּהוּ לְאֻמִּים׃
verses.english: He who says to the wicked, Thou art in the right; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

verses.hebrew: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִים יִנְעָם וַעֲלֵיהֶם תָּבוֹא בִרְכַּת־טוֹב׃
verses.english: but those who rebuke the wicked shall have delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

verses.hebrew: שְׂפָתַיִם יִשָּׁק מֵשִׁיב דְּבָרִים נְכֹחִים׃
verses.english: Like a kiss on the lips, it is when one gives a right answer.

verses.hebrew: הָכֵן בַּחוּץ מְלַאכְתֶּךָ וְעַתְּדָהּ בַּשָּׂדֶה לָךְ אַחַר וּבָנִיתָ בֵיתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Prepare thy work outside, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thy house.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי עֵד־חִנָּם בְּרֵעֶךָ וַהֲפִתִּיתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֹּאמַר כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לִי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ אָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ כְּפָעֳלוֹ׃
verses.english: Do not say, I will do so to him as he has done to me: I will render to the man according to his deeds.

verses.hebrew: עַל־שְׂדֵה אִישׁ־עָצֵל עָבַרְתִּי וְעַל־כֶּרֶם אָדָם חֲסַר־לֵב׃
verses.english: I went by the field of a lazy man, and by the vineyard of a man void of understanding;

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כֻלּוֹ קִמְּשֹׂנִים כָּסּוּ פָנָיו חֲרֻלִּים וְגֶדֶר אֲבָנָיו נֶהֱרָסָה׃
verses.english: and, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered it over, and its stone wall was broken down.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶחֱזֶה אָנֹכִי אָשִׁית לִבִּי רָאִיתִי לָקַחְתִּי מוּסָר׃
verses.english: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.

verses.hebrew: מְעַט שֵׁנוֹת מְעַט תְּנוּמוֹת מְעַט חִבֻּק יָדַיִם לִשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep

verses.hebrew: וּבָא־מִתְהַלֵּךְ רֵישֶׁךָ וּמַחְסֹרֶיךָ כְּאִישׁ מָגֵן׃
verses.english: so shall thy poverty come like a marauder; and thy want like an armed man.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֵלֶּה מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר הֶעְתִּיקוּ אַנְשֵׁי חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: These also are proverbs of Shelomo, which the men of Ḥizqiyya, king of Yehuda copied out.

verses.hebrew: כְּבֹד אֱלֹהִים הַסְתֵּר דָּבָר וּכְבֹד מְלָכִים חֲקֹר דָּבָר׃
verses.english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמַיִם לָרוּם וָאָרֶץ לָעֹמֶק וְלֵב מְלָכִים אֵין חֵקֶר׃
verses.english: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.

verses.hebrew: הָגוֹ סִיגִים מִכָּסֶף וַיֵּצֵא לַצֹּרֵף כֶּלִי׃
verses.english: Take away the dross from the silver, and a vessel emerges for the refiner.

verses.hebrew: הָגוֹ רָשָׁע לִפְנֵי־מֶלֶךְ וְיִכּוֹן בַּצֶּדֶק כִּסְאוֹ׃
verses.english: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְהַדַּר לִפְנֵי־מֶלֶךְ וּבִמְקוֹם גְּדֹלִים אַל־תַּעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: Do not give thyself airs in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men: for better it is that it be said to thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב אֲמָר־לְךָ עֲ‍לֵה הֵנָּה מֵהַשְׁפִּילְךָ לִפְנֵי נָדִיב אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Come up here; than that thou shouldst be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thy eyes have seen.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּצֵא לָרִב מַהֵר פֶּן מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָהּ בְּהַכְלִים אֹתְךָ רֵעֶךָ׃
verses.english: Do not proceed hastily to litigation, lest thou know not what to do in the end of it, when thy neighbour has put thee to shame.

verses.hebrew: רִיבְךָ רִיב אֶת־רֵעֶךָ וְסוֹד אַחֵר אַל־תְּגָל׃
verses.english: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour: and do not reveal the secret of another:

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יְחַסֶּדְךָ שֹׁמֵעַ וְדִבָּתְךָ לֹא תָשׁוּב׃
verses.english: lest he who hears thee betray thee; and lest thy calumny be carried back.

verses.hebrew: תַּפּוּחֵי זָהָב בְּמַשְׂכִּיּוֹת כָּסֶף דָּבָר דָּבֻר עַל־אָפְנָיו׃
verses.english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in ornaments of silver.

verses.hebrew: נֶזֶם זָהָב וַחֲלִי־כָתֶם מוֹכִיחַ חָכָם עַל־אֹזֶן שֹׁמָעַת׃
verses.english: Like an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

verses.hebrew: כְּצִנַּת־שֶׁלֶג בְּיוֹם קָצִיר צִיר נֶאֱמָן לְשֹׁלְחָיו וְנֶפֶשׁ אֲדֹנָיו יָשִׁיב׃
verses.english: Like the cold snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him: for he refreshes the soul of his master.

verses.hebrew: נְשִׂיאִים וְרוּחַ וְגֶשֶׁם אָיִן אִישׁ מִתְהַלֵּל בְּמַתַּת־שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: One who boasts of gifts that he does not give is like clouds and wind without rain.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרֶךְ אַפַּיִם יְפֻתֶּה קָצִין וְלָשׁוֹן רַכָּה תִּשְׁבָּר־גָּרֶם׃
verses.english: By long forbearing is a ruler won over, and a soft tongue breaks the bone.

verses.hebrew: דְּבַשׁ מָצָאתָ אֱכֹל דַּיֶּךָּ פֶּן־תִּשְׂבָּעֶנּוּ וַהֲקֵאתוֹ׃
verses.english: Hast thou found honey? eat as much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be sated with it, and vomit it up.

verses.hebrew: הֹקַר רַגְלְךָ מִבֵּית רֵעֶךָ פֶּן־יִשְׂבָּעֲךָ וּשְׂנֵאֶךָ׃
verses.english: Let thy foot be seldom in thy neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of thee, and hate thee.

verses.hebrew: מֵפִיץ וְחֶרֶב וְחֵץ שָׁנוּן אִישׁ עֹנֶה בְרֵעֵהוּ עֵד שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: A man who bears false witness against his neighbour is like a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁן רֹעָה וְרֶגֶל מוּעָדֶת מִבְטָח בּוֹגֵד בְּיוֹם צָרָה׃
verses.english: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

verses.hebrew: מַעֲדֶה בֶּגֶד בְּיוֹם קָרָה חֹמֶץ עַל־נָתֶר וְשָׁר בַּשִּׁרִים עַל לֶב־רָע׃
verses.english: Like one who takes off a garment in cold weather, and like acid upon nitre, is he who sings songs to a heavy heart.

verses.hebrew: אִם־רָעֵב שֹׂנַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵהוּ לָחֶם וְאִם־צָמֵא הַשְׁקֵהוּ מָיִם׃
verses.english: If thy enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

verses.hebrew: כִּי גֶחָלִים אַתָּה חֹתֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיהוָה יְשַׁלֶּם־לָךְ׃
verses.english: for thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord shall reward thee.

verses.hebrew: רוּחַ צָפוֹן תְּחוֹלֵל גָּשֶׁם וּפָנִים נִזְעָמִים לְשׁוֹן סָתֶר׃
verses.english: The north wind brings in the rain: so does an angry countenance, a back biting tongue.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב שֶׁבֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּג מֵאֵשֶׁת מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] וּבֵית חָבֶר׃
verses.english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a roomy house.

verses.hebrew: מַיִם קָרִים עַל־נֶפֶשׁ עֲיֵפָה וּשְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה מֵאֶרֶץ מֶרְחָק׃
verses.english: As cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

verses.hebrew: מַעְיָן נִרְפָּשׂ וּמָקוֹר מָשְׁחָת צַדִּיק מָט לִפְנֵי־רָשָׁע׃
verses.english: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is like a muddied fountain, and a polluted spring.

verses.hebrew: אָכֹל דְּבַשׁ הַרְבּוֹת לֹא־טוֹב וְחֵקֶר כְּבֹדָם כָּבוֹד׃
verses.english: It is not good to eat much honey: so it is honour to set bounds to honour.

verses.hebrew: עִיר פְּרוּצָה אֵין חוֹמָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵין מַעְצָר לְרוּחוֹ׃
verses.english: He that has no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

verses.hebrew: כַּשֶּׁלֶג בַּקַּיִץ וְכַמָּטָר בַּקָּצִיר כֵּן לֹא־נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל כָּבוֹד׃
verses.english: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

verses.hebrew: כַּצִּפּוֹר לָנוּד כַּדְּרוֹר לָעוּף כֵּן קִלְלַת חִנָּם לא [לוֹ] תָבֹא׃
verses.english: Like a wandering sparrow, like a flying swallow, so a curse that is causeless comes home to roost.

verses.hebrew: שׁוֹט לַסּוּס מֶתֶג לַחֲמוֹר וְשֵׁבֶט לְגֵו כְּסִילִים׃
verses.english: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּעַן כְּסִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ פֶּן־תִּשְׁוֶה־לּוֹ גַם־אָתָּה׃
verses.english: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, lest thou become like him thyself.

verses.hebrew: עֲנֵה כְסִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ פֶּן־יִהְיֶה חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

verses.hebrew: מְקַצֶּה רַגְלַיִם חָמָס שֹׁתֶה שֹׁלֵחַ דְּבָרִים בְּיַד־כְּסִיל׃
verses.english: He that sends a message by the hand of a fool cuts off his own feet, and drinks in damage.

verses.hebrew: דַּלְיוּ שֹׁקַיִם מִפִּסֵּחַ וּמָשָׁל בְּפִי כְסִילִים׃
verses.english: Like the legs of a lame man which hang useless, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.hebrew: כִּצְרוֹר אֶבֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָה כֵּן־נוֹתֵן לִכְסִיל כָּבוֹד׃
verses.english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he that gives honour to a fool.

verses.hebrew: חוֹחַ עָלָה בְיַד־שִׁכּוֹר וּמָשָׁל בְּפִי כְסִילִים׃
verses.english: Like a thorn that goes up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.hebrew: רַב מְחוֹלֵל־כֹּל וְשֹׂכֵר כְּסִיל וְשֹׂכֵר עֹבְרִים׃
verses.english: A master craftsman performs everything; but he who hires a fool is as he who hires the passersby.

verses.hebrew: כְּכֶלֶב שָׁב עַל־קֵאוֹ כְּסִיל שׁוֹנֶה בְאִוַּלְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: As a dog returns to his vomit, so a fool returns to his folly.

verses.hebrew: רָאִיתָ אִישׁ חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו תִּקְוָה לִכְסִיל מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: Seest thou a man wise in his own eyes? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר עָצֵל שַׁחַל בַּדָּרֶךְ אֲרִי בֵּין הָרְחֹבוֹת׃
verses.english: The lazy man says, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

verses.hebrew: הַדֶּלֶת תִּסּוֹב עַל־צִירָהּ וְעָצֵל עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: As the doors turns on its hinges, so does the slothful upon his bed.

verses.hebrew: טָמַן עָצֵל יָדוֹ בַּצַּלָּחַת נִלְאָה לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ אֶל־פִּיו׃
verses.english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; it grieves him to bring it back to his mouth.

verses.hebrew: חָכָם עָצֵל בְּעֵינָיו מִשִּׁבְעָה מְשִׁיבֵי טָעַם׃
verses.english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men that can give sensible reasons.

verses.hebrew: מַחֲזִיק בְּאָזְנֵי־כָלֶב עֹבֵר מִתְעַבֵּר עַל־רִיב לֹּא־לוֹ׃
verses.english: He who passes by, and meddles with a strife not his own, is like one who takes a dog by the ears.

verses.hebrew: כְּמִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶה זִקִּים חִצִּים וָמָוֶת׃
verses.english: As a madman who throws firebrands, arrows, and death,

verses.hebrew: כֵּן־אִישׁ רִמָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְאָמַר הֲ‍לֹא־מְשַׂחֵק אָנִי׃
verses.english: so is a man who tricks his neighbour, and says, But I was only joking!

verses.hebrew: בְּאֶפֶס עֵצִים תִּכְבֶּה־אֵשׁ וּבְאֵין נִרְגָּן יִשְׁתֹּק מָדוֹן׃
verses.english: Where no wood is, there the fire goes out: so where there is no talebearer, strife ceases.

verses.hebrew: פֶּחָם לְגֶחָלִים וְעֵצִים לְאֵשׁ וְאִישׁ מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] לְחַרְחַר־רִיב׃
verses.english: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי נִרְגָּן כְּמִתְלַהֲמִים וְהֵם יָרְדוּ חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃
verses.english: The words of a talebearer are like dainties, and they go down into the innermost parts of the body.

verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף סִיגִים מְצֻפֶּה עַל־חָרֶשׂ שְׂפָתַיִם דֹּלְקִים וְלֶב־רָע׃
verses.english: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like an earthenware dish covered with silver dross.

verses.hebrew: בשפתו [בִּשְׂפָתָיו] יִנָּכֵר שׂוֹנֵא וּבְקִרְבּוֹ יָשִׁית מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: He who hates dissembles with his lips, and lays up deceit within him;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְחַנֵּן קוֹלוֹ אַל־תַּאֲמֶן־בּוֹ כִּי שֶׁבַע תּוֹעֵבוֹת בְּלִבּוֹ׃
verses.english: when he speaks fair, do not believe him: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.hebrew: תִּכַּסֶּה שִׂנְאָה בְּמַשָּׁאוֹן תִּגָּלֶה רָעָתוֹ בְקָהָל׃
verses.english: He whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be revealed before the whole congregation.

verses.hebrew: כֹּרֶה־שַּׁחַת בָּהּ יִפֹּל וְגֹלֵל אֶבֶן אֵלָיו תָּשׁוּב׃
verses.english: The one who digs a pit shall fall into it: and if one rolls a stone, it will return upon him.

verses.hebrew: לְשׁוֹן־שֶׁקֶר יִשְׂנָא דַכָּיו וּפֶה חָלָק יַעֲשֶׂה מִדְחֶה׃
verses.english: A lying tongue hates its victims; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּיוֹם מָחָר כִּי לֹא־תֵדַע מַה־יֵּלֶד יוֹם׃
verses.english: Do not boast thyself of tomorrow; for thou knowst not what today may bring forth.

verses.hebrew: יְהַלֶּלְךָ זָר וְלֹא־פִיךָ נָכְרִי וְאַל־שְׂפָתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Let another man praise thee, and not thy own mouth; a stranger, and not thy own lips.

verses.hebrew: כֹּבֶד־אֶבֶן וְנֵטֶל הַחוֹל וְכַעַס אֱוִיל כָּבֵד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than both of them.

verses.hebrew: אַכְזְרִיּוּת חֵמָה וְשֶׁטֶף אָף וּמִי יַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי קִנְאָה׃
verses.english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before envy?

verses.hebrew: טוֹבָה תּוֹכַחַת מְגֻלָּה מֵאַהֲבָה מְסֻתָּרֶת׃
verses.english: Open rebuke is better than hidden love.

verses.hebrew: נֶאֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵי אוֹהֵב וְנַעְתָּרוֹת נְשִׁיקוֹת שׂוֹנֵא׃
verses.english: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ שְׂבֵעָה תָּבוּס נֹפֶת וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה כָּל־מַר מָתוֹק׃
verses.english: The full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.hebrew: כְּצִפּוֹר נוֹדֶדֶת מִן־קִנָּהּ כֵּן־אִישׁ נוֹדֵד מִמְּקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his place.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁמֶן וּקְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּח־לֵב וּמֶתֶק רֵעֵהוּ מֵעֲצַת־נָפֶשׁ׃
verses.english: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so does the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

verses.hebrew: רֵעֲךָ ורעה [וְרֵעַ] אָבִיךָ אַל־תַּעֲזֹב וּבֵית אָחִיךָ אַל־תָּבוֹא בְּיוֹם אֵידֶךָ טוֹב שָׁכֵן קָרוֹב מֵאָח רָחוֹק׃
verses.english: Do not forsake thy own friend, and thy father’s friend; nor go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

verses.hebrew: חֲכַם בְּנִי וְשַׂמַּח לִבִּי וְאָשִׁיבָה חֹרְפִי דָבָר׃
verses.english: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him who taunts me.

verses.hebrew: עָרוּם רָאָה רָעָה נִסְתָּר פְּתָאיִם עָבְרוּ נֶעֱנָשׁוּ׃
verses.english: A prudent man sees the evil, and hides himself; but simpletons pass on, and are punished.

verses.hebrew: קַח־בִּגְדוֹ כִּי־עָרַב זָר וּבְעַד נָכְרִיָּה חַבְלֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Take his garment when he is surety for a stranger, and take his pledge on behalf of an alien woman.

verses.hebrew: מְבָרֵךְ רֵעֵהוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל בַּבֹּקֶר הַשְׁכֵּים קְלָלָה תֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ׃
verses.english: He that blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

verses.hebrew: דֶּלֶף טוֹרֵד בְּיוֹם סַגְרִיר וְאֵשֶׁת מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] נִשְׁתָּוָה׃
verses.english: A continual dripping on a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

verses.hebrew: צֹפְנֶיהָ צָפַן־רוּחַ וְשֶׁמֶן יְמִינוֹ יִקְרָא׃
verses.english: Whoever would hide her hides the wind, like the ointment of his right hand, which betrays itself.

verses.hebrew: בַּרְזֶל בְּבַרְזֶל יָחַד וְאִישׁ יַחַד פְּנֵי־רֵעֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Iron sharpens iron; so one man sharpens another.

verses.hebrew: נֹצֵר תְּאֵנָה יֹאכַל פִּרְיָהּ וְשֹׁמֵר אֲדֹנָיו יְכֻבָּד׃
verses.english: He who guards the fig tree shall eat its fruit: so he who waits on his master shall be honoured.

verses.hebrew: כַּמַּיִם הַפָּנִים לַפָּנִים כֵּן לֵב־הָאָדָם לָאָדָם׃
verses.english: As in water face answers to face, so the heart of man to man.

verses.hebrew: שְׁאוֹל ואבדה [וַאֲבַדּוֹ] לֹא תִשְׂבַּעְנָה וְעֵינֵי הָאָדָם לֹא תִשְׂבַּעְנָה׃
verses.english: She᾽ol and Avaddon are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

verses.hebrew: מַצְרֵף לַכֶּסֶף וְכוּר לַזָּהָב וְאִישׁ לְפִי מַהֲלָלוֹ׃
verses.english: The refining pot is for silver, arid the furnace for gold; and a man is tried according to his praise.

verses.hebrew: אִם תִּכְתּוֹשׁ־אֶת־הָאֱוִיל בַּמַּכְתֵּשׁ בְּתוֹךְ הָרִיפוֹת בַּעֱלִי לֹא־תָסוּר מֵעָלָיו אִוַּלְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: Though thou shouldst grind a fool in a mortar among crushed grain with a pestle, yet will his foolishness not depart from him.

verses.hebrew: יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע פְּנֵי צֹאנֶךָ שִׁית לִבְּךָ לַעֲדָרִים׃
verses.english: Be diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא לְעוֹלָם חֹסֶן וְאִם־נֵזֶר לְדוֹר דור [וָדוֹר׃]
verses.english: For riches are not forever: and does the crown endure to all generations?

verses.hebrew: גָּלָה חָצִיר וְנִרְאָה־דֶשֶׁא וְנֶאֶסְפוּ עִשְּׂבוֹת הָרִים׃
verses.english: When the grass sprouts forth, and the young grass appears, and the herbs on the mountains are gathered in;

verses.hebrew: כְּבָשִׂים לִלְבוּשֶׁךָ וּמְחִיר שָׂדֶה עַתּוּדִים׃
verses.english: lambs shall provide thy clothing, and goats the price of a field:

verses.hebrew: וְדֵי חֲלֵב עִזִּים לְלַחְמְךָ לְלֶחֶם בֵּיתֶךָ וְחַיִּים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: and thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance of thy maidens.

verses.hebrew: נָסוּ וְאֵין־רֹדֵף רָשָׁע וְצַדִּיקִים כִּכְפִיר יִבְטָח׃
verses.english: The wicked flee when no man pursues: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע אֶרֶץ רַבִּים שָׂרֶיהָ וּבְאָדָם מֵבִין יֹדֵעַ כֵּן יַאֲרִיךְ׃
verses.english: When the land is sinful, its princes are numerous: but when there is a judicious man, knowing what is right, he shall endure.

verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר רָשׁ וְעֹשֵׁק דַּלִּים מָטָר סֹחֵף וְאֵין לָחֶם׃
verses.english: A poor man that oppresses the weak is like a sweeping rain which leaves no food.

verses.hebrew: עֹזְבֵי תוֹרָה יְהַלְלוּ רָשָׁע וְשֹׁמְרֵי תוֹרָה יִתְגָּרוּ בָם׃
verses.english: They who forsake Tora praise the wicked: but such as keep Tora contend with them.

verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי־רָע לֹא־יָבִינוּ מִשְׁפָּט וּמְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה יָבִינוּ כֹל׃
verses.english: Evil men understand not justice: but they who seek the Lord understand all things.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־רָשׁ הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ מֵעִקֵּשׁ דְּרָכַיִם וְהוּא עָשִׁיר׃
verses.english: Better is the poor who walks in his uprightness, than he who deals perversely in his ways, though he be rich.

verses.hebrew: נוֹצֵר תּוֹרָה בֵּן מֵבִין וְרֹעֶה זוֹלְלִים יַכְלִים אָבִיו׃
verses.english: A wise son keeps Tora, but he that is a companion of riotous men shames his father.

verses.hebrew: מַרְבֶּה הוֹנוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ ובתרבית [וְתַרְבִּית] לְחוֹנֵן דַּלִּים יִקְבְּצֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: He who by usury and unjust gain increases his substance, gathers it for him who will graciously regard the poor.

verses.hebrew: מֵסִיר אָזְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹעַ תּוֹרָה גַּם־תְּפִלָּתוֹ תּוֹעֵבָה׃
verses.english: He who turns away his ear from hearing Tora, even his prayer is abomination.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׁגֶּה יְשָׁרִים בְּדֶרֶךְ רָע בִּשְׁחוּתוֹ הוּא־יִפּוֹל וּתְמִימִים יִנְחֲלוּ־טוֹב׃
verses.english: He who causes the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the innocent shall inherit good.

verses.hebrew: חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו אִישׁ עָשִׁיר וְדַל מֵבִין יַחְקְרֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that has understanding searches him out.

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲלֹץ צַדִּיקִים רַבָּה תִפְאָרֶת וּבְקוּם רְשָׁעִים יְחֻפַּשׂ אָדָם׃
verses.english: When righteous men rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

verses.hebrew: מְכַסֶּה פְשָׁעָיו לֹא יַצְלִיחַ וּמוֹדֶה וְעֹזֵב יְרֻחָם׃
verses.english: He that covers up his sins shall not prosper: but whoever confesses and forsakes them shall have mercy.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם מְפַחֵד תָּמִיד וּמַקְשֶׁה לִבּוֹ יִפּוֹל בְּרָעָה׃
verses.english: Happy is the man who fears always: but he who hardens his heart shall fall into mischief.

verses.hebrew: אֲרִי־נֹהֵם וְדֹב שׁוֹקֵק מֹשֵׁל רָשָׁע עַל עַם־דָּל׃
verses.english: As a roaring lion, and a hungry bear, so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

verses.hebrew: נָגִיד חֲסַר תְּבוּנוֹת וְרַב מַעֲשַׁקּוֹת שנאי [שֹׂנֵא] בֶצַע יַאֲרִיךְ יָמִים׃
verses.english: The prince who lacks understanding is also a great oppressor: but the one who hates covetousness shall prolong his days.

verses.hebrew: אָדָם עָשֻׁק בְּדַם־נָפֶשׁ עַד־בּוֹר יָנוּס אַל־יִתְמְכוּ־בוֹ׃
verses.english: A man that is burdened with the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let none support him.

verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים יִוָּשֵׁעַ וְנֶעְקַשׁ דְּרָכַיִם יִפּוֹל בְּאֶחָת׃
verses.english: He who walks uprightly shall be saved: but he who takes crooked paths shall fall suddenly.

verses.hebrew: עֹבֵד אַדְמָתוֹ יִשְׂבַּע־לָחֶם וּמְרַדֵּף רֵקִים יִשְׂבַּע־רִישׁ׃
verses.english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread: but he who follows after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אֱמוּנוֹת רַב־בְּרָכוֹת וְאָץ לְהַעֲשִׁיר לֹא יִנָּקֶה׃
verses.english: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he who makes haste to be rich shall not go unpunished.

verses.hebrew: הַכֵּר־פָּנִים לֹא־טוֹב וְעַל־פַּת־לֶחֶם יִפְשַׁע־גָּבֶר׃
verses.english: To have respect of persons is not good: for a man will transgress for a piece of bread.

verses.hebrew: נִבֳהָל לַהוֹן אִישׁ רַע עָיִן וְלֹא־יֵדַע כִּי־חֶסֶר יְבֹאֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: The man of evil eye is eager for wealth: he does not know that want will come upon him.

verses.hebrew: מוֹכִיחַ אָדָם אַחֲרַי חֵן יִמְצָא מִמַּחֲלִיק לָשׁוֹן׃
verses.english: He who rebukes a man shall find more favour afterwards than he who flatters with the tongue.

verses.hebrew: גּוֹזֵל אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאֹמֵר אֵין־פָּשַׁע חָבֵר הוּא לְאִישׁ מַשְׁחִית׃
verses.english: He who robs his father or his mother, and says, It is no transgression; he is companion of a destroyer.

verses.hebrew: רְחַב־נֶפֶשׁ יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וּבוֹטֵחַ עַל־יְהוָה יְדֻשָּׁן׃
verses.english: He that is of a greedy heart stirs up strife: but he that puts his trust in the Lord shall be made rich.

verses.hebrew: בּוֹטֵחַ בְּלִבּוֹ הוּא כְסִיל וְהוֹלֵךְ בְּחָכְמָה הוּא יִמָּלֵט׃
verses.english: He who trusts in his own heart is a fool: but he who walks wisely, shall escape.

verses.hebrew: נוֹתֵן לָרָשׁ אֵין מַחְסוֹר וּמַעְלִים עֵינָיו רַב־מְאֵרוֹת׃
verses.english: He who gives to the poor shall not lack: but he who hides his eyes shall have many a curse.

verses.hebrew: בְּקוּם רְשָׁעִים יִסָּתֵר אָדָם וּבְאָבְדָם יִרְבּוּ צַדִּיקִים׃
verses.english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ תּוֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה־עֹרֶף פֶּתַע יִשָּׁבֵר וְאֵין מַרְפֵּא׃
verses.english: He, that being often reproved hardens his neck, shall suddenly be broken, beyond healing.

verses.hebrew: בִּרְבוֹת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמַח הָעָם וּבִמְשֹׁל רָשָׁע יֵאָנַח עָם׃
verses.english: When the righteous are on the increase, the people rejoice: but when the wicked man bears rule, the people mourn.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־אֹהֵב חָכְמָה יְשַׂמַּח אָבִיו וְרֹעֶה זוֹנוֹת יְאַבֶּד־הוֹן׃
verses.english: He who loves wisdom gladdens his father: but he who keeps company with harlots wastes his substance.

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִיד אָרֶץ וְאִישׁ תְּרוּמוֹת יֶהֶרְסֶנָּה׃
verses.english: The king by justice establishes the land: but he who exacts gifts overthrows it.

verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר מַחֲלִיק עַל־רֵעֵהוּ רֶשֶׁת פּוֹרֵשׂ עַל־פְּעָמָיו׃
verses.english: A man who flatters his neighbour spreads a net for his feet.

verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע אִישׁ רָע מוֹקֵשׁ וְצַדִּיק יָרוּן וְשָׂמֵחַ׃
verses.english: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous man sings and rejoices.

verses.hebrew: יֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק דִּין דַּלִּים רָשָׁע לֹא־יָבִין דָּעַת׃
verses.english: The righteous man apprehends the cause of the poor: but the wicked man cannot grasp that knowledge.

verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי לָצוֹן יָפִיחוּ קִרְיָה וַחֲכָמִים יָשִׁיבוּ אָף׃
verses.english: Scornful men stir up a city into strife: but wise men turn away wrath.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־חָכָם נִשְׁפָּט אֶת־אִישׁ אֱוִיל וְרָגַז וְשָׂחַק וְאֵין נָחַת׃
verses.english: If a wise man contends with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־תָם וִישָׁרִים יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: The bloodthirsty hate the innocent: but the just seek his good.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־רוּחוֹ יוֹצִיא כְסִיל וְחָכָם בְּאָחוֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶנָּה׃
verses.english: A fool vents all his anger: but a wise man keeping it in subdues it.

verses.hebrew: מֹשֵׁל מַקְשִׁיב עַל־דְּבַר־שָׁקֶר כָּל־מְשָׁרְתָיו רְשָׁעִים׃
verses.english: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

verses.hebrew: רָשׁ וְאִישׁ תְּכָכִים נִפְגָּשׁוּ מֵאִיר־עֵינֵי שְׁנֵיהֶם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the Lord gives light to the eyes of both.

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ שׁוֹפֵט בֶּאֱמֶת דַּלִּים כִּסְאוֹ לָעַד יִכּוֹן׃
verses.english: The king who faithfully judges the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁבֶט וְתוֹכַחַת יִתֵּן חָכְמָה וְנַעַר מְשֻׁלָּח מֵבִישׁ אִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself brings shame to his mother.

verses.hebrew: בִּרְבוֹת רְשָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה־פָּשַׁע וְצַדִּיקִים בְּמַפַּלְתָּם יִרְאוּ׃
verses.english: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases: both the righteous shall witness their fall.

verses.hebrew: יַסֵּר בִּנְךָ וִינִיחֶךָ וְיִתֵּן מַעֲדַנִּים לְנַפְשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; and he will give delight to thy soul.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין חָזוֹן יִפָּרַע עָם וְשֹׁמֵר תּוֹרָה אַשְׁרֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Where there is no vision, the people become unruly: but happy is he who keeps Tora.

verses.hebrew: בִּדְבָרִים לֹא־יִוָּסֶר עָבֶד כִּי־יָבִין וְאֵין מַעֲנֶה׃
verses.english: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understands he will not answer.

verses.hebrew: חָזִיתָ אִישׁ אָץ בִּדְבָרָיו תִּקְוָה לִכְסִיל מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.hebrew: מְפַנֵּק מִנֹּעַר עַבְדּוֹ וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ יִהְיֶה מָנוֹן׃
verses.english: He who pampers his servant from a child shall have him become his master at last.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־אַף יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וּבַעַל חֵמָה רַב־פָּשַׁע׃
verses.english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a furious man abounds in transgression.

verses.hebrew: גַּאֲוַת אָדָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶנּוּ וּשְׁפַל־רוּחַ יִתְמֹךְ כָּבוֹד׃
verses.english: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but the humble in spirit shall attain honour.

verses.hebrew: חוֹלֵק עִם־גַּנָּב שׂוֹנֵא נַפְשׁוֹ אָלָה יִשְׁמַע וְלֹא יַגִּיד׃
verses.english: Whoever is partner with a thief is his own enemy: he hears the adjuration of witnesses, but discloses nothing.

verses.hebrew: חֶרְדַּת אָדָם יִתֵּן מוֹקֵשׁ וּבוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה יְשֻׂגָּב׃
verses.english: The fear of man brings a snare: but he who puts his trust in the Lord shall be protected.

verses.hebrew: רַבִּים מְבַקְשִׁים פְּנֵי־מוֹשֵׁל וּמֵיְהוָה מִשְׁפַּט־אִישׁ׃
verses.english: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but a man’s judgment comes from the Lord.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת צַדִּיקִים אִישׁ עָוֶל וְתוֹעֲבַת רָשָׁע יְשַׁר־דָּרֶךְ׃
verses.english: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.

verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי אָגוּר בִּן־יָקֶה הַמַּשָּׂא נְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר לְאִיתִיאֵל לְאִיתִיאֵל וְאֻכָל׃
verses.english: The words of Agur son of Yaqe, the burden. Thus says the man, I am weary, O God, I am weary, O God, and I am consumed:

verses.hebrew: כִּי בַעַר אָנֹכִי מֵאִישׁ וְלֹא־בִינַת אָדָם לִי׃
verses.english: for I am more brutish than a man, and have not the understanding of a man.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־לָמַדְתִּי חָכְמָה וְדַעַת קְדֹשִׁים אֵדָע׃
verses.english: I have not learned wisdom; that I should desire to have the knowledge of the holy.

verses.hebrew: מִי עָלָה־שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד מִי אָסַף־רוּחַ בְּחָפְנָיו מִי צָרַר־מַיִם בַּשִּׂמְלָה מִי הֵקִים כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ מַה־שְּׁמוֹ וּמַה־שֶּׁם־בְּנוֹ כִּי תֵדָע׃
verses.english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and come down again? who has gathered the wind in his fists? who has bound the waters in a garment? who has established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אִמְרַת אֱלוֹהַּ צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃
verses.english: Every word of God is proven: he is a shield to those who put their trust in him.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תּוֹסְףְּ עַל־דְּבָרָיו פֶּן־יוֹכִיחַ בְּךָ וְנִכְזָבְתָּ׃
verses.english: Add not to his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

verses.hebrew: שְׁתַּיִם שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תִּמְנַע מִמֶּנִּי בְּטֶרֶם אָמוּת׃
verses.english: Two things have I asked of thee; do not deny me them before I die:

verses.hebrew: שָׁוְא וּדְבַר־כָּזָב הַרְחֵק מִמֶּנִּי רֵאשׁ וָעֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּתֶּן־לִי הַטְרִיפֵנִי לֶחֶם חֻקִּי׃
verses.english: remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with my allotted portion:

verses.hebrew: פֶּן אֶשְׂבַּע וְכִחַשְׁתִּי וְאָמַרְתִּי מִי יְהוָה וּפֶן־אִוָּרֵשׁ וְגָנַבְתִּי וְתָפַשְׂתִּי שֵׁם אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: lest I become sated, and deny thee, and say, Who is the Lord? or lest I be poor, and steal, and violate the name of my God.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּלְשֵׁן עֶבֶד אֶל־אדנו [אֲדֹנָיו] פֶּן־יְקַלֶּלְךָ וְאָשָׁמְתָּ׃
verses.english: Accuse not a servant to his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

verses.hebrew: דּוֹר אָבִיו יְקַלֵּל וְאֶת־אִמּוֹ לֹא יְבָרֵךְ׃
verses.english: There is a generation that curse their father, and do not bless their mother.

verses.hebrew: דּוֹר טָהוֹר בְּעֵינָיו וּמִצֹּאָתוֹ לֹא רֻחָץ׃
verses.english: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet are not washed from their filthiness.

verses.hebrew: דּוֹר מָה־רָמוּ עֵינָיו וְעַפְעַפָּיו יִנָּשֵׂאוּ׃
verses.english: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

verses.hebrew: דּוֹר חֲרָבוֹת שִׁנָּיו וּמַאֲכָלוֹת מְתַלְּעֹתָיו לֶאֱכֹל עֲנִיִּים מֵאֶרֶץ וְאֶבְיוֹנִים מֵאָדָם׃
verses.english: There is a generation, whose teeth are like swords, and their jaw teeth like knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

verses.hebrew: לַעֲלוּקָה שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת הַב הַב שָׁלוֹשׁ הֵנָּה לֹא תִשְׂבַּעְנָה אַרְבַּע לֹא־אָמְרוּ הוֹן׃
verses.english: The leech has two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied; four that never say, It is enough.

verses.hebrew: שְׁאוֹל וְעֹצֶר רָחַם אֶרֶץ לֹא־שָׂבְעָה מַּיִם וְאֵשׁ לֹא־אָמְרָה הוֹן׃
verses.english: She᾽ol; and the barren womb; the earth that is never sated with water; and the fire that never says, It is enough.

verses.hebrew: עַיִן תִּלְעַג לְאָב וְתָבוּז לִיקֲּהַת־אֵם יִקְּרוּהָ עֹרְבֵי־נַחַל וְיֹאכְלוּהָ בְנֵי־נָשֶׁר׃
verses.english: The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young vultures shall eat it.

verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁה הֵמָּה נִפְלְאוּ מִמֶּנִּי וארבע [וְאַרְבָּעָה] לֹא יְדַעְתִּים׃
verses.english: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ הַנֶּשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם דֶּרֶךְ נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי צוּר דֶּרֶךְ־אֳנִיָּה בְלֶב־יָם וְדֶרֶךְ גֶּבֶר בְּעַלְמָה׃
verses.english: the way of the vultures in the air; the way of a snake upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a young woman.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן דֶּרֶךְ אִשָּׁה מְנָאָפֶת אָכְלָה וּמָחֲתָה פִיהָ וְאָמְרָה לֹא־פָעַלְתִּי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Likewise the way of an adulterous woman; she eats, and wipes her mouth, and says, I have done nothing wrong.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת שָׁלוֹשׁ רָגְזָה אֶרֶץ וְתַחַת אַרְבַּע לֹא־תוּכַל שְׂאֵת׃
verses.english: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four it cannot bear:

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־עֶבֶד כִּי יִמְלוֹךְ וְנָבָל כִּי יִשְׂבַּע־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: for a slave when he becomes king; and a fool when he is filled with food;

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת שְׂנוּאָה כִּי תִבָּעֵל וְשִׁפְחָה כִּי־תִירַשׁ גְּבִרְתָּהּ׃
verses.english: for an unloved woman when she is married; and a handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

verses.hebrew: אַרְבָּעָה הֵם קְטַנֵּי־אָרֶץ וְהֵמָּה חֲכָמִים מְחֻכָּמִים׃
verses.english: There are four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:

verses.hebrew: הַנְּמָלִים עַם לֹא־עָז וַיָּכִינוּ בַקַּיִץ לַחְמָם׃
verses.english: the ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their bread in the summer;

verses.hebrew: שְׁפַנִּים עַם לֹא־עָצוּם וַיָּשִׂימוּ בַסֶּלַע בֵּיתָם׃
verses.english: the badgers are but a feeble folk, yet they make their houses in the rocks;

verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ אֵין לָאַרְבֶּה וַיֵּצֵא חֹצֵץ כֻּלּוֹ׃
verses.english: the locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

verses.hebrew: שְׂמָמִית בְּיָדַיִם תְּתַפֵּשׂ וְהִיא בְּהֵיכְלֵי מֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The lizard clambers up with her hands, and she is in king’s palaces.

verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁה הֵמָּה מֵיטִיבֵי צָעַד וְאַרְבָּעָה מֵיטִבֵי לָכֶת׃
verses.english: There are three things which are stately in their tread; four are comely in their stride:

verses.hebrew: לַיִשׁ גִּבּוֹר בַּבְּהֵמָה וְלֹא־יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי־כֹל׃
verses.english: a lion which is strongest among beasts, and does not turn away for anyone;

verses.hebrew: זַרְזִיר מָתְנַיִם אוֹ־תָיִשׁ וּמֶלֶךְ אַלְקוּם עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: a greyhound; a he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

verses.hebrew: אִם־נָבַלְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂא וְאִם־זַמּוֹתָ יָד לְפֶה׃
verses.english: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting thyself up, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִיץ חָלָב יוֹצִיא חֶמְאָה וּמִיץ־אַף יוֹצִיא דָם וּמִיץ אַפַּיִם יוֹצִיא רִיב׃
verses.english: Surely the wringing of milk brings forth curd, and the wringing of the nose brings forth blood: so the forcing of wrath brings forth strife.

verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי לְמוּאֵל מֶלֶךְ מַשָּׂא אֲ‍שֶׁר־יִסְּרַתּוּ אִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: The words of king Lemu᾽el, the prophecy, that his mother taught him.

verses.hebrew: מַה־בְּרִי וּמַה־בַּר־בִּטְנִי וּמֶה בַּר־נְדָרָי׃
verses.english: What, my son? and what, son of my womb? and what, son of my vows?

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן לַנָּשִׁים חֵילֶךָ וּדְרָכֶיךָ לַמְחוֹת מְלָכִין׃
verses.english: Give not thy strength to women, nor thy ways to those who destroy kings.

verses.hebrew: אַל לַמְלָכִים לְמוֹאֵל אַל לַמְלָכִים שְׁתוֹ־יָיִן וּלְרוֹזְנִים או [אֵי] שֵׁכָר׃
verses.english: It is not for kings, O Lemu᾽el, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes to say, Where is strong drink?

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִשְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּח מְחֻקָּק וִישַׁנֶּה דִּין כָּל־בְּנֵי־עֹנִי׃
