verses.english: Lest he drink, and forget the decree, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

verses.hebrew: תְּנוּ־שֵׁכָר לְאוֹבֵד וְיַיִן לְמָרֵי נָפֶשׁ׃
verses.english: Give strong drink to him that is ready to perish, and wine to those of heavy hearts.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּח רִישׁוֹ וַעֲמָלוֹ לֹא יִזְכָּר־עוֹד׃
verses.english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

verses.hebrew: פְּתַח־פִּיךָ לְאִלֵּם אֶל־דִּין כָּל־בְּנֵי חֲלוֹף׃
verses.english: Open thy mouth for the dumb, in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

verses.hebrew: פְּתַח־פִּיךָ שְׁפָט־צֶדֶק וְדִין עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

verses.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת־חַיִל מִי יִמְצָא וְרָחֹק מִפְּנִינִים מִכְרָהּ׃
verses.english: Who can find a woman of worth? for her price is far above rubies.

verses.hebrew: בָּטַח בָּהּ לֵב בַּעְלָהּ וְשָׁלָל לֹא יֶחְסָר׃
verses.english: The heart of her husband safely trusts in her, and he shall have no lack of gain.

verses.hebrew: גְּמָלַתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא־רָע כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיה׃
verses.english: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

verses.hebrew: דָּרְשָׁה צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים וַתַּעַשׂ בְּחֵפֶץ כַּפֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: She seeks wool, and flax, and works willingly with her hands.

verses.hebrew: הָיְתָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ׃
verses.english: She is like the merchant ships; she brings her food from afar.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ וְחֹק לְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: She rises also while it is yet night, and gives food to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

verses.hebrew: זָמְמָה שָׂדֶה וַתִּקָּחֵהוּ מִפְּרִי כַפֶּיהָ נטע [נָטְעָה] כָּרֶם׃
verses.english: She considers a field, and buys it: with the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.

verses.hebrew: חָגְרָה בְעוֹז מָתְנֶיהָ וַתְּאַמֵּץ זְרֹעוֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: She girds her loins with strength, and she makes her arms strong.

verses.hebrew: טָעֲמָה כִּי־טוֹב סַחְרָהּ לֹא־יִכְבֶּה בליל [בַלַּיְלָה] נֵרָהּ׃
verses.english: She perceives that her merchandise is good: her candle does not go out by night.

verses.hebrew: יָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה בַכִּישׁוֹר וְכַפֶּיהָ תָּמְכוּ פָלֶךְ׃
verses.english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her palms hold the spindle.

verses.hebrew: כַּפָּהּ פָּרְשָׂה לֶעָנִי וְיָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה לָאֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: She stretches out her palm to the poor; yea, she reaches forth her hands to the needy.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִירָא לְבֵיתָהּ מִשָּׁלֶג כִּי כָל־בֵּיתָהּ לָבֻשׁ שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

verses.hebrew: מַרְבַדִּים עָשְׂתָה־לָּהּ שֵׁשׁ וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָׁהּ׃
verses.english: She makes herself coverlets; her clothing is fine linen and purple.

verses.hebrew: נוֹדָע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ בְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עִם־זִקְנֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

verses.hebrew: סָדִין עָשְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּר וַחֲגוֹר נָתְנָה לַכְּנַעֲנִי׃
verses.english: She makes garments, and sells them; and delivers girdles to the merchant.

verses.hebrew: עֹז־וְהָדָר לְבוּשָׁהּ וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרוֹן׃
verses.english: Strength and dignity are her clothing; and she laughs at the time to come.

verses.hebrew: פִּיהָ פָּתְחָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת־חֶסֶד עַל־לְשׁוֹנָהּ׃
verses.english: She opens her mouth with wisdom; and on her tongue is a Tora of steadfast love.

verses.hebrew: צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ וְלֶחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל׃
verses.english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and does not eat the bread of idleness.

verses.hebrew: קָמוּ בָנֶיהָ וַיְאַשְּׁרוּהָ בַּעְלָהּ וַיְהַלְלָהּ׃
verses.english: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:

verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל־כֻּלָּנָה׃
verses.english: many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר הַחֵן וְהֶבֶל הַיֹּפִי אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת־יְהוָה הִיא תִתְהַלָּל׃
verses.english: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman who fears the Lord, she shall be praised.

verses.hebrew: תְּנוּ־לָהּ מִפְּרִי יָדֶיהָ וִיהַלְלוּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִים מַעֲשֶׂיהָ׃
verses.english: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her deeds praise her in the gates.
